# DSH Classroom / 课堂纪要

A local-first DeepSeek Harness plugin for English/Chinese classes. Import recordings, capture microphone audio, produce timestamped transcripts, anonymous speaker labels, bilingual translation and rolling summaries. Create a separate enhanced edition from the saved recording plus slides and video frames.

**Pre-release:** this plugin provides a pipeline, not a guarantee of commercial-service accuracy or latency. Test with your classroom microphone and recordings before relying on the notes. Human review remains necessary for ambiguous speech, equations, names, accents and overlapping speakers.

## 0.6.0：完整迁移与课堂复习工作台

- **迁移复查与修正**：新备份包含知识、原件、独立笔记历史、回收内容，以及停止处理的课堂任务、音频片段、逐字稿修订、批注和播放器时间轴。SHA-256 清单在合并前验证；文件损坏/缺失、路径越界、重复 ZIP 条目或空间不足会报错。导出前需结束录音并完成或暂停分析。旧版 ZIP 可读，但缺少的历史任务和完整性清单不能凭空补回。
- **安全合并**：恢复任务使用新编号并重定位本机路径，绑定到发起恢复的当前项目/对话；保留本机现有任务和笔记，不自动执行备份中的推理。相同备份重复导入复用已恢复的任务；更新过的任务形成新快照。回收状态和独立笔记历史一并保存。备份较大，导出、暂存和合并需要足够磁盘空间；它是本机可携带备份，没有云同步或账号服务。
- **手写与截图批注**：白板画笔、颜色/粗细、橡皮、撤销；可导入截图，或点击按钮通过 Chrome 人工选择共享范围截取一张。保存为带时间/页码的 PNG，可排队让现有 Gemma 读取，识别内容进入摘要与知识检索。批注图片进入项目归档、完整备份和 Word/PDF 附录。跨次编辑保存的是图片，不是无限可逆的矢量笔画；模糊手写可能无法识别。
- **复习模板**：课堂笔记、康奈尔、考前复习/自测、解题推导、会议纪要；可用于新录音或基于完整资料重新生成，模板变更不会复用旧模板的总结缓存。考前模板不会预测真实试题。
- **同步复习**：CPU 多语言语义匹配课件页与转写时间段，展示页图、原文和可回听候选；可以手动校准起止时间并确认，确认结果持久保存。语义分数不是准确率，当前不承诺自动精确同步、跨播放器完整兼容或短暂画面不遗漏。
- **多选整理**：项目内按标题筛选课堂记录/独立知识笔记，分页、多选、批量移入回收区/恢复，导出所选记录 ZIP 或合并笔记 Markdown。原件保留，永久删除仍需单条明确确认。
- **运行与安装**：增加 Windows `scripts/setup-windows.bat`，可检查/引导安装 Node、uv、FFmpeg、Ollama，准备隔离 Python/语音/检索模型，并安装指定公开固定提交。已有组件不会强制升级，不改 Codex CLI、启动器或模型上下文。首次 DSH/Ollama 模型连接仍使用官方设置；新电脑还需有足够显存、磁盘、下载权限及驱动。WinGet 组件可需要系统安装权限。
- **故障恢复**：原生录音异常退出后清理失效的运行标志；点击继续时尝试恢复尚未确认的本地音频片段。无法解码的末尾数据会记录警告，不能恢复从未录到的声音。批注识别失败可随记录继续处理。Windows PowerShell 5.1 的中文脚本编码已修正。

安装来源说明：[Microsoft WinGet](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/package-manager/winget/install)、[uv 官方安装](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/)、[FFmpeg 下载](https://ffmpeg.org/download.html)、[Ollama Windows](https://ollama.com/download/windows)。本版本没有增加常驻 GPU 模型。

## 0.5.0：课堂工作台与持久知识库

下面保留 0.5.0 的架构和使用说明；新备份/复习功能以 0.6.0 节为准。

在原对话点击 **课堂**，可切换 **录音 / 文件、Chrome 视频、知识库**。所有页面使用现有 DSH 端口和认证，不替换启动入口，也不修改独立 Codex CLI。

- **知识保存**：课堂原文、翻译、摘要、时间点笔记、课件页图分析、视频画面证据自动入库。原始导入资料按 SHA-256 复制保存，移动用户原文件不会破坏后续引用。没有成功提取的文件也保留资料目录条目和失败状态，不能冒充已读懂内容。
- **现成数据层优先**：复用 `dsh-knowledge-base-local@1.2.5` 的 Markdown、版本、回收和 BM25 数据层，保留其许可证。没有挂载它的独立 Host HTTP/MCP 路由。参见 THIRD_PARTY.md。
- **中英检索与问答**：多语言 E5 small INT8 在 CPU 上运行，语义向量按原文块持久保存，结合 BM25 检索；默认当前项目，可显式选择全部课程。问答只收到实际检索的原文，回答保留可读取的来源；无有效来源编号时返回资料不足。检索分数不是准确率，无法保证每个问法都召回所有知识。
- **自动附件入库**：DSH 原生消息附件会保存原始副本并去重排队。为避免同一块显卡抢占，自动 GPU 分析在当前 DSH 回复结束后启动。回答前自动进行当前项目检索；排队成功不等于分析完成。
- **转写先显示**：浏览器录音默认约 5 秒一块，可选 10/15 秒；转写先保存，翻译和摘要随后排队。页面显示等待分析的段数。不是词级连续流式，冷启动、分人及模型切换会增加延迟。
- **聊天和课堂共用显卡**：通过 DSH 公开推理/会话事件协调，聊天开始前等待当前课堂推理步骤结束并释放 ASR；聊天产生完整助手消息后再继续课堂队列。原始音频采集持续。其他 Ollama/CLI/游戏客户端不在这项协调范围内，不能承诺任意外部并发都满足 16 GB。云端聊天可配置 `coordinateChatGPU:false`。
- **持续麦克风录音**：Windows 可先列出设备，人工选择并点击“开始本机持续录音”。FFmpeg 采集独立于网页；关闭网页仍采集，退出 DSH 则结束，子进程由 Windows Job Object 保护。已关闭片段落盘，异常重启后的分析可继续；最后未完整写出的片段仍可能损失。设备/驱动兼容性需要实机确认。Chrome 标签页共享仍需页面保持打开和人工授权，不能静默续接浏览器共享。
- **校对与分人**：点句回听、播放高亮、逐句校对、说话人名称、合并、按时间段修正、修订历史和恢复。原 ASR 检查点保留。校对会标记旧翻译和摘要过时，过时内容退出知识检索；重新总结会重译过时块并遍历所有保存的原文，采用有检查点的分层归纳。人工重写后单词时间对齐失效，保留句子时间。
- **课堂笔记**：保存时间点、课件名称/页码与书签；设置术语表供后续转写使用。关键词提醒可在页面显示，桌面通知需用户允许。后台节流、系统睡眠和页面关闭会影响浏览器提醒。
- **双区域与多播放器**：可分别保存课件、教授裁剪区域，各自取样去重；字幕助手分别记录它能访问的播放器，用户选择主时间轴以及区域对应时间轴。无法访问的跨域 iframe 仍需在授权的独立播放器页连接。不是连续原视频存档或逐帧理解，DOM 重排、播放器版本及学校网站仍需验证。
- **课件时间对应**：保留页面和取样时间，并对全部转写块提供词语重合的候选对应；候选明确标为未验证，不把相似内容当作精确同步。可通过时间点笔记人工关联。PPTX 复杂版式仍推荐先导出 PDF。
- **文件和迁移**：批量导入音视频/课件；增加 Word/PDF 导出，保留 Markdown/SRT。PDF/Word 渲染标题、段落、列表、表格和代码；复杂 LaTeX 保留源表达式。完整 ZIP 包含原始资料和知识数据，可在另一台机器合并到当前项目；原有知识保留。持续云同步和多人协同需要另行指定服务，未偷偷开放 LAN/公网端口。
- **清理与维护**：回收区支持明确输入标题后永久删除记录及缓存；原始知识资料另外保留。可预览并明确清理超过保留天数、没有引用的原始资料，默认不自动删除。提供依赖自检、固定 SHA 安装与回滚 `.bat`/PowerShell 入口。清理不会删除用户原始输入文件。

### 准备语义检索

已准备过语音环境时运行 `scripts/setup-knowledge.ps1`；新环境运行 `scripts/setup.ps1 -DownloadModels`，会一起准备 CPU 检索模型。模型按固定上游 revision 下载，权重不包含在插件包中。未准备好时保留 BM25 检索并显示提示。

知识目录默认为 `$DSH_HOME/classroom/knowledge`：`docs` 是可直接阅读的 Markdown，`assets` 保存原始资料，`semantic` 是可重建的 CPU 向量，`versions/trash` 保存版本和回收内容。卸载插件不删除这些资料。持久储存和来源检索降低遗忘风险，不构成零丢失、零幻觉或所有文件都可解析的保证。

### 验证范围

单元/协议测试、真实短英文音频与本地 Gemma、实际 CPU 中英检索、带来源问答、备份合并、Word/PDF 页面检查分别验证。四小时文件验收使用首尾英文语音、中间大量静音的合成时间线，240 个块完成；它不是四小时真实课堂、实体麦克风或学校播放器的实机压力测试。具体证据以发布验收记录为准，不拿安装成功或测试数量代替质量结论。

## Install

### Chrome streaming playback (0.2.0)

Open `/classroom/watch` from the existing authenticated DSH origin. Click the
capture button, choose the Chrome tab playing the lecture, and enable tab audio.
The browser picker is a human action. This does not retrieve media manifests,
download URLs, cookies or DRM material. Capture runs while this page stays open.

Audio is saved in recoverable 15-second PCM chunks and uses the existing local
Whisper/Gemma queue. Changed screen frames are sampled at a minimum 12-second
interval by default; static content is deduplicated, with a periodic 60-second
evidence frame. Drag on the preview to crop to the slide area. The real saved
images, visual interpretations, player captions, queue counts and report are
visible. Translation/summary work shares one inference queue; delays are reported.
This is sampled interpretation, not exhaustive frame-by-frame video understanding.

Optional `chrome-companion/` is a tiny Manifest V3 extension with `activeTab`,
`scripting`, session storage and loopback-only host permissions. Load that folder
with Chrome's **Load unpacked**, then copy a pairing code from the capture page,
open the video tab, click the extension and connect. The content script reads
visible caption cues and video time only in the tab you connect. No broad site
permission is requested. Pairing can write only clock/caption metadata to one
local job, expires after 16 hours, is rotated on regeneration and revoked on stop.
Reconnection is required after navigation/browser or DSH restart. Some players
do not expose native caption cues; their visible captions are still available in
sampled images, and full speech uses audio ASR. No promise is made that every
Panopto theme's DOM caption layout is supported without testing.

Capture seconds and lecture/player seconds are stored separately. Pause, seek and
speed changes from the companion create fresh anchors. Stale/missing anchors
produce an unknown course time rather than a fabricated one. Manual calibration
is available, but is intentionally short-lived. Finish first, wait for the audio
and frames, then add slides/videos for an enhanced edition with the saved audio,
screen evidence and timing report; the original job stays intact. Screen-only
sessions can produce a report; audio-based enhanced transcription requires audio.

The DSH model can read an existing capture through the typed `watch_playback`
tool. A successful start is not a completed analysis. Long sessions and the
actual school's Panopto instance need practical validation.

Version 0.1.8 adds a typed DSH `read_document` tool, native-upload receipt resolution,
PDF page images, paginated reads and a tool-discipline hook. Every new user input
executes a local `tool_context` probe before inference and automatically reads the
first three native attachments (three units each). Remaining units/files require
explicit reads. Failed/partial reads are marked. The Stop hook requests at most
two corrections for missing web evidence or missing file readback. Streaming
drafts are not hidden; this is evidence guidance and bounded runtime correction,
not a guarantee that a small model cannot hallucinate. Set `toolDiscipline: false`
in the classroom profile row to disable the hooks while keeping the file reader.
This hook applies only to DSH; the separate CLI configuration is unchanged.
`tool_help` returns a live tool schema; failed calls receive the real schema or
an unknown-name correction. Schema lookup is not counted as task/source evidence.

Use the official native attachment button. The third-party `dsh-file-upload`
0.5.4 has a conflicting `read_document` tool and was observed failing with
`cannot get property "fs" without inject` on DSH 0.2.0-rc.2; remove that optional
bundle before enabling this reader. Removing it does not remove native upload.

Requires Windows, Node 22+, DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2, Ollama, uv, FFmpeg/ffprobe on PATH, and an NVIDIA GPU with sufficient available VRAM. Python 3.12 runs in a separate environment. No official launcher or package is patched.

1. Download a fixed GitHub release/tag and inspect the source.
2. Run `scripts/setup.ps1 -DownloadModels`. This explicitly installs the Python environment and downloads upstream model weights; installation/startup does not run it automatically.
3. Add the release package using `dsh plugin --profile web add <package.tgz>`.
4. Start DSH normally. Open the **课堂纪要** link, or `/classroom` on the same authenticated DSH origin. The plugin uses DSH's existing port and authentication.

Runtime and models default to `~/.local-ai-tools/classroom`. Recordings, results and checkpoints default to `$DSH_HOME/classroom` or `~/.dsh/classroom`. They are not stored in the plugin checkout. Removing the plugin does not delete recordings.

Override paths in the profile patch:

```yaml
- id: classroom
  name: dsh-classroom
  config:
    pythonExecutable: 'C:\path\to\python.exe'
    modelsDirectory: 'C:\path\to\models'
    dataDirectory: 'C:\path\to\recordings'
    ffmpegExecutable: 'C:\path\to\ffmpeg.exe'
    ollamaURL: http://127.0.0.1:11434
    model: gemma4:12b-it-qat
```

## Recording and enhancement

### Conversation and project workflow (0.3.0)

### Record management and titles (0.4.0)

The in-conversation result cards and both capture panels provide **改名/修改标题**, **自动命名/根据内容命名**, **删除记录**, **回收区**, and **恢复**. Deletion is recoverable: the selected stopped job's cache and generated archive move into the central `recycle-bin`, while original imported files remain untouched. The record disappears from active lists, search and result cards. Stop/cancel active work first; remove dependent enhanced editions before their source recording. No automatic permanent purge is installed. Directory moves use canonical bounds checks and bounded Windows sharing-violation retries; cross-volume/locked moves may fail, leaving the original record available for retry rather than deleting it permanently.

Leave the course-name field blank to generate a specific title from transcript/summary evidence after analysis completes. The configured local Ollama model receives at most 5,000 characters and returns a bounded JSON title; it is not called on every chunk. Manually entered titles are preserved. Existing records can request a new automatic title explicitly. Model failure leaves the completed analysis usable, keeps the old title and reports a title warning. Title changes update generated reports and the job's archive folder in the same project; subsequent cards/search use the new path. Earlier textual notices may still mention the previous path.

The official Session-scoped composer slot now contains a **课堂** button. It opens an embedded recording/file-analysis or Chrome-capture panel while the conversation remains available. A **课堂任务与结果** card above the composer displays the current conversation's latest five tasks, progress, archive errors, summary excerpts, file links and actual output paths. Durable plugin notices also enter Session history for subsequent model questions; DSH does not display these notices as ordinary assistant bubbles. The panel shows the actual Session `cwd` and output directory; sidebar grouping labels are not used as filesystem paths. Collapsing the panel keeps its recording alive; closing/reloading the browser still interrupts collection. Microphone and screen-sharing permissions require a human action.

Tasks created from the embedded panel or `classroom` conversation tool bind to their originating Session and canonical workspace. Generated minutes, a readable transcript, SRT subtitles, captured frames/material evidence and recording audio (for live/watch jobs) are archived into `cwd/课堂记录/date-title-jobId/`. Source audio files for file analysis remain at their original path, recorded in `记录信息.json`; they are not duplicated. The central cache/checkpoints remain intact. Completion or failure posts a durable notice to the originating conversation without triggering an extra LLM response. Archive failures keep source results and retry; the project's job metadata exposes `archiveError`. Links include absolute output paths for workspace file tools.

The tool supports `open` (`{"mode":"record"}` or `{"mode":"watch"}`) and bounded literal `search` (`{"query":"kinetic energy","limit":15}`) over archived reports in the current project, as well as the existing analysis operations. `open` asks the browser UI to open the panel; it never starts capture silently. Cross-project job access is rejected by scoped operations. Legacy standalone `/classroom` remains available with its global record list; existing unbound jobs are not moved automatically. Browser pending-upload queues are isolated by Session in the embedded workflow. Existing legacy pending uploads remain in the standalone page's original database.

Project bindings and notification status persist in the central `project-bindings.json`. Renamed/deleted workspace directories and directory junctions pointing outside the workspace fail explicitly. Two simultaneous browser clients may operate the same project, but each job's original notification destination is preserved. These protections scope classroom outputs; they do not sandbox all other DSH tools.

- Microphone PCM is uploaded as independently decodable WAV chunks, approximately every 5 seconds by default (configurable 5/10/15). Keep the page open while recording. Pending chunks are stored in browser IndexedDB and retry after connection recovery; the server acknowledges only after writing a durable copy. The most recent unsubmitted buffer can be lost if the browser crashes.
- **Real-time:** faster-whisper large-v3-turbo, GPU `int8_float16`, then CPU speaker segmentation/embedding. Translation and summaries use the configured local Ollama model. Queue length and phases show lag; this is chunk-based processing, not instantaneous streaming.
- **File/enhanced:** large-v3 by default, in bounded 60-second blocks. Raw audio and the real-time edition remain separate. A new enhanced job links to its parent.
- Restarted jobs pause with their checkpoints intact. Click **继续处理** to resume. Cancel stops processing and preserves data.
- Markdown reports and SRT subtitles remain in each job directory. Word-level anonymous speaker labels and speaker-turn timestamps remain in JSON results. Labels can change across revisions and are not real-world identity recognition.
- ASR loads only on GPU. When VRAM is insufficient it asks Ollama to unload only the configured classroom model (including an existing chat lease on that same model). Other Ollama models and other applications are left alone. Any remaining shortage fails after a bounded 120-second wait with a resumable error; there is no CPU fallback. The streaming model is released before image analysis, a new LLM load, completion, or 60 seconds without queued work. File-quality weights are released after each block. Available-memory checks are a guard, not a universal VRAM guarantee against concurrent applications.
- Classroom Gemma requests use a five-minute keep-alive. When work finishes or the inference queue is idle for 60 seconds, the worker also requests immediate unloading of its own last Gemma lease. If another client has refreshed that lease, normal cleanup leaves it alone. Ollama is shared across clients: simultaneous calls can race with lease inspection, and reloading after ASR yields adds latency. Set the Ollama server's global `OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE` to `5m` as well so ordinary DSH chat cannot leave a 24-hour lease. Closing the worker abruptly leaves the model to expire instead of running cleanup.
- Inference is serialized with microphone chunks prioritized. File jobs yield after each 60-second audio block; source analysis yields after each page/frame or summary step. A currently running inference still has to finish. DSH chat inference is coordinated through public events; other clients are not covered, and waiting increases live latency.

## Formats and evidence

Audio/video support follows the installed FFmpeg build, including ordinary M4A/AAC, MP3, WAV, FLAC, OGG/Opus, MP4, MOV, MKV and WebM. M4A is a container; codec, encryption and file integrity determine decodability.

PDF uses page text and rendered page images, including scanned PDFs via the vision model. PPTX uses text, notes and embedded images; export to PDF for complete slide layout. DOCX uses paragraphs/tables. XLSX/XLSM uses sheet cells and formulas without executing macros. Text/code/configuration files use bounded text blocks. Opaque binary and proprietary engineering formats require their own converter and are explicitly rejected.

Videos are analyzed through sampled visual frames **and** transcribed audio. Default frame interval is 30 seconds and can be changed. Every sampled timestamp is recorded. This is not continuous or every-frame comprehension; brief events between samples may be missed. Long materials use hierarchical summaries; report references support checking the original source.

Additional videos supplied for enhancement have their own audio transcription and timestamp references. They are not assumed to share the recording's timeline. Engineering exchange files (DXF, STEP/IGES, STL/OBJ/PLY/OFF/glTF) can be read with `scripts/setup.ps1 -Engineering`: established CPU parsers return geometry metadata and visual previews. Mesh previews are sampled. DWG, SolidWorks/CATIA and proprietary PCB formats require vendor conversion; feature histories, constraints and all proprietary formats are not supported.

## Architecture / security

The DSH plugin registers a tool, an authenticated UI and API on the existing Connection service. A lazy Python worker uses a JSON-lines pipe; it opens no additional TCP port. Worker failure is reported to the UI/tool and does not prevent the DSH host from starting. Uploads stream to disk with a configurable size limit and incomplete-upload cleanup. Paths for report retrieval accept only validated job IDs.

User speech, files and summaries go to local disk and local Ollama. Setup downloads dependencies and weights from public registries/upstream repositories. The plugin does not provide cloud transcription, paid services, account sign-in or automatic startup tasks.

## Models and licenses

Plugin code: MIT. Dependencies and model weights retain their own licenses; weights are downloaded separately and not redistributed in this package.

- [faster-whisper](https://github.com/SYSTRAN/faster-whisper), [large-v3](https://huggingface.co/Systran/faster-whisper-large-v3), [large-v3-turbo](https://huggingface.co/mobiuslabsgmbh/faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo).
- [sherpa-onnx](https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx), official ONNX segmentation-3.0 release with its MIT license, and WeSpeaker VoxCeleb ResNet34-LM embedding release.

## Development checks

### Optional Codex CLI interoperability adapter

`scripts/mcp-guard.mjs` wraps a tools-only stdio MCP server that silently ignores resource discovery. It returns empty resource lists, forwards tool requests unchanged, and fails timed-out requests explicitly. Example: `node scripts/mcp-guard.mjs node path/to/dsh-memory-mcp.mjs`. This does not change the upstream memory plugin or its storage. Use it only for tools-only servers; resource-capable servers should connect directly.

```powershell
node --test test/worker-client.test.mjs
python test/worker.test.py
node --check lib/index.js
python -m py_compile backend/worker.py
npm pack --dry-run --ignore-scripts
```

Unit checks cover retry idempotency, checkpoint recovery, path validation, bounded document previews, missing runtime handling and request routing. Real ASR/diarization, GPU-memory measurements, local-model translation and browser flow checks require the installed runtime/models and are separate from unit tests.

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# Blaxel Sandbox for DeepSeek Harness

Version 0.1.4 moves a DeepSeek Harness Web conversation and its current Git worktree to an independent DSH host in a private Blaxel sandbox. Once the cloud page is ready, model requests and tools continue there with the originating computer offline. Earlier tools-only versions require the original host to stay running.

Use [GUIDE.md](GUIDE.md) for setup and recovery, and [the cloud handoff contract](docs/cloud-session-handoff.md) for implementation status and tested boundaries.

## Move, continue, review, return

1. Select **Move to Blaxel** in an existing Git-backed conversation. A running task checkpoints after its current tool finishes.
2. The plugin restores the project, native conversation history, referenced images, and supported child-session history in a private cloud host, then opens the same conversation there.
3. Continue in the cloud page. **Copy private link** provides access from another device; opening from the original computer renews an expired link automatically.
4. On the original computer with DSH running, select **Move back to local**. Review changed files and the exact patch, then apply the transfer.
5. The conversation and checked changes return together. The laptop's original permission policy is restored before it resumes. Move to Blaxel again to include newer local work.

The local copy remains read-only while the cloud owns execution. Compatible local file edits survive the return; conflicts retain both copies and save a recovery patch. Reopening connects to the existing sandbox without uploading a new local snapshot.

## Session architecture

```text
Local DSH -> private Blaxel DSH host -> reviewed files and conversation back locally
```

Blaxel credentials remain on the original computer. The selected model's portable API key is supplied to the dedicated cloud process so its agent can run independently. Local-only model endpoints and OAuth grants cannot be handed off by this implementation.

## Compatibility

DeepSeek Harness is in developer preview and its plugin contracts change between release candidates. Each plugin release pins one DSH version and is verified against it with the full check, a clean-profile install, and a DSH Web boot.

| Plugin | DSH host | Node.js |
| -- | -- | -- |
| `0.1.4`, `0.1.3` | `0.1.2-rc.1` | 22.19+, 24+ |
| `0.1.2`, `0.1.1` | `0.1.2-rc.1` | 22, 24 |
| `0.1.0` | `0.1.1-rc.2` | 22, 24 |

When DSH publishes a new version, the plugin is re-verified against it and, when a Host contract moved, a new plugin release pins the new version. Older hosts keep the last plugin release that pinned them.

## Profile installation

Install the current plugin into the DSH Web profile with the native helpers it requires:

```sh
npx --yes --package @blaxel/dsh-sandbox@latest dsh-blaxel plugin --profile web add \
  --allow-build=@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local \
  --allow-build=koffi \
  --allow-build=node-pty \
  --allow-build=@google/genai \
  --allow-build=protobufjs \
  @blaxel/dsh-sandbox@latest
npx --yes --package @blaxel/dsh-sandbox@latest dsh-blaxel web
```

## Development installation

```sh
git clone https://github.com/blaxel-ai/deepseek-harness-blaxel-sandbox.git
cd deepseek-harness-blaxel-sandbox
pnpm install
pnpm build
dsh plugin --profile web link "$PWD"
node dist/cli.js web
```

`dsh-blaxel` prepares an isolated, pinned DSH 0.1.2-rc.1 runtime on first launch and reuses it afterward. It includes the native history-import extension needed to preserve original timestamps. It uses your existing DSH profile; it does not modify your global DSH installation. Node.js, npm and Git must be available. Keep the same `DSH_HOME` if you use a custom profile.

Sign in from **Settings > Blaxel**, or authenticate on the host with `bl login YOUR-WORKSPACE`.

`pnpm check` runs lint, types, unit tests, build, and publint. `pnpm e2e` additionally boots the pinned `dsh-blaxel` runtime with the selected profile and runs the Playwright browser smoke suite (`pnpm exec playwright install chromium` once).

## Workspace launch

The launch action is available when the session directory is inside a Git worktree. It:

1. Lists tracked files and unignored untracked files.
2. Excludes common credential and private-key paths.
3. Creates a bounded archive without `.git` or `.dsh-blaxel` state.
4. Restores the worktree under `/workspace` in a Blaxel sandbox.
5. Restores the same native session ID in a dedicated cloud DSH process.
6. Opens its authenticated private preview after the cloud host is ready.

The launch panel reports real file counts and the active phase. A failed launch stays in the current session with its error instead of creating an empty page.

Before any sandbox is created, the plugin verifies that the session's selected model route is active and that its resolved credential is configured. If a writable credential is missing, the composer shows a secure provider-specific setup card. Saving the key writes it to the DSH host credential store, verifies the model again, and continues the original sandbox action. The selected portable model API key is forwarded to the cloud process; it is never returned to the browser. Blaxel credentials remain local.

## Configuration

| Variable | Default | Purpose |
|---|---:|---|
| `DSH_BLAXEL_IMAGE` | `blaxel/ts-app:latest` | Sandbox image |
| `DSH_BLAXEL_MEMORY` | `4096` | Sandbox memory in MB |
| `DSH_BLAXEL_REGION` | automatic | Sandbox region |
| `DSH_BLAXEL_TTL` | 24h for cloud sessions | Maximum lifetime from sandbox creation |

CI may provide `BL_WORKSPACE` and `BL_API_KEY`. Blaxel credentials remain local; only the selected portable model key enters the cloud host.

## Blaxel Settings

The Blaxel settings section provides browser OAuth with workspace selection, existing CLI profile switching, and sandbox defaults verified against the active account's memory and TTL quotas, workspace regions, and available Hub images. Official Blaxel skills and OAuth-connected resource MCP status stay at the top. API-key login remains available as an advanced fallback.

It also lists every running sandbox session with its session ID, runtime name, remote workspace, uptime, state, and owned tool-process count. Stopping one sandbox removes its remote runtime binding without closing or replacing the DSH page.

## Development

Keyless verification:

```sh
pnpm check
pnpm pack
```

The opt-in live test creates a real sandbox:

```sh
DSH_BLAXEL_LIVE=1 pnpm vitest run tests/live.test.ts tests/live-roundtrip.test.ts
```

Do not run the live test without authorization to use the target Blaxel workspace.

## Runnable example

[Invoice Desk](examples/invoice-desk) is the dependency-free application used in the cloud walkthrough. Run its ten tests locally, then use the same project for a reviewed round trip.

## Security and lifecycle

- Blaxel authentication remains host-side.
- Local sessions retain DSH's local sandbox policy.
- Sandbox sessions route to the remote filesystem and subprocess providers. A failed remote operation never falls back to the host.
- Git-ignored files and common credential files such as `.env`, `.npmrc`, private keys, and credential JSON are omitted from workspace snapshots.
- A running task checkpoints at a safe tool boundary before continuing on the cloud host.
- Moving is an explicit round trip, not continuous synchronization. `Return to local` conflict-checks sandbox changes against the original worktree, applies them only when safe, stops that sandbox, and keeps the same DSH session local. The session can later move into a fresh sandbox again.
- Each runtime is deleted only when stopped. Restarting DSH reconnects the same native session to its existing sandbox.
- Reconnecting keeps existing sandbox files and does not upload newer local edits. To bring local work into that session, move back to local, merge any conflicts, then move to Blaxel again. See the [file-change scenarios](GUIDE.md#move-changes-back-to-local).
- Telemetry is limited to attribution: Blaxel API and sandbox requests carry the Blaxel SDK `User-Agent` with `deepseek-harness-blaxel-sandbox/<version>` appended. Nothing is collected from DSH, the conversation, or the workspace.

# DeepSeekBot [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/deepseekbot?color=CB3837&logo=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/deepseekbot) [![Website](https://img.shields.io/badge/website-deepseekbot.app-3D5AFE)](https://deepseekbot.app/en/) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot?style=flat&logo=github)](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot) [![MIT license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/blob/main/LICENSE) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-join-5865F2?logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/aEB2Ayhu7B) **DeepSeekBot (DSB): the open-source Grok Bot alternative for DeepSeek Harness.** A crew of bots, each with its own identity, persona and memory, working together. [Website](https://deepseekbot.app/en/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot) · [Docs](https://botharness.ai) · [中文](#中文)
DeepSeekBot installs into [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) as one plugin: a Bot roster, DMs and Groups, Git Memory you can see, delegation, and IM identities of the Bots' own. DeepSeekBot (DSB) is a different project from DS Bot (npm `ds-bot`); see [how they differ](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/blob/main/README.en.md#deepseek-bot-projects). - **Open-source Grok Bot alternative**, MIT licensed - **Built on DeepSeek Harness**: any model provider you connect in DSH works - **Works with other DSH plugins** in the same Profile - **Lark / Feishu, Slack, Discord, QQ and WeChat**: Bots speak under their own identity ## Install **Desktop:** in the DeepSeek Harness desktop app, go to **Plugins → Add plugin**, enter `deepseekbot`, keep the official npm registry and click **Install**, then **Enable now**. **Bot mode** appears in the sidebar. **CLI:** needs Node 22+ and DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 or later in the 0.2.x line. 1.4.1 is tested on 0.2.1-rc.2, the version the command below installs. ```bash npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2 dsh plugin --profile web add deepseekbot dsh web ``` Open **Bot mode**, create a PersonaBot, DM it, then start a Group and invite members. To use Lark, Slack, Discord, QQ or WeChat, connect the app in **Settings → IM bots**, then bind the identity and authorize a group in the Bot's Profile. Accounts start disconnected; you turn each one on. ## Every Bot is a colleague - **Lasting identity:** each PersonaBot keeps its own name, Soul (SOUL.md) and avatar across chats, Sessions and Workspaces. - **Git Memory you can see:** a Bot's memory is a plain Git working tree. Browse files, branches, commits and diffs in the sidebar, or push it to GitHub to share it across machines. - **Groups:** messages keep each Bot's identity, and you @ whoever you need. - **Assignments:** grant a Workspace and a Bot can delegate independent Assignments, each with its own Session and report. - **Their own IM identity:** when mentioned in an authorized group or thread, a Bot replies there under its own identity. - **Schedules:** have a Bot do something every few minutes, every hour or every day; add one in the sidebar or just ask the Bot, and lock it when the Bot shouldn't change it. - **Bot Marketplace:** install a Bot someone shared on the [Bot Marketplace](https://deepseekbot.app/en/market), or [share your own](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/blob/main/docs/share-bot.md). - **Update notes:** after an install or update, Bot mode shows what changed, and Bot settings check npm for a newer version. More screenshots and per-version highlights are in the [GitHub README](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot#screenshots). ## Pixel avatars Every Bot's default avatar is generated from its name, and while a Bot works its avatar morphs into the tool it is using. Try it on the [website](https://deepseekbot.app/en/avatar); avatars come from [BotPixel](https://github.com/BotHarness/BotPixel). ## Built on DeepSeek Harness DeepSeekBot runs on DSH's own session management and harness, so any LLM provider you connect in DSH works for your Bots, and it installs alongside other DSH plugins. Some plugins may not be compatible yet; please open an [issue](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/issues) or a PR if you hit one. ## Community - Discord: [discord.gg/aEB2Ayhu7B](https://discord.gg/aEB2Ayhu7B) - QQ group: 1125565676 - Issues: [github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/issues](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/issues) --- ## 中文 **DeepSeekBot（DSB）：开源的 GrokBot 平替。一组有各自身份、人格和记忆的 bots，一起做事。** DeepSeekBot 以一个插件装进 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）：Bot 名册、私聊与 Group、看得见的 Git Memory、定时任务、Bot 市场、任务委派，以及 Bot 自己的 IM 身份（飞书 / Lark、Slack、Discord、QQ、微信）。DeepSeekBot（简称 DSB）与 DS Bot（npm `ds-bot`）是两个独立项目，区别见 [GitHub README](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot#deepseek-bot-projects)。它直接用 DSH 的 Session 管理和 Harness，你在 DSH 里接入的任何模型 provider 都能用，也能和其他 DSH 插件装在一起。 **桌面端**：打开 DeepSeek Harness，点「插件 → 添加插件」，在「包名或地址」里输入 `deepseekbot`，点「安装」，再点「立即启用」。 **命令行**：需要 Node 22+，支持 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 起的 0.2.x 版本。1.4.1 在 0.2.1-rc.2 上测试，下面的命令安装的就是这个版本。 ```bash npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2 dsh plugin --profile web add deepseekbot dsh web ``` 更多截图和各版本亮点见 [GitHub README](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/blob/main/README.md#screenshots)。 官网：[deepseekbot.app](https://deepseekbot.app) · 源码：[GitHub](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot) · Discord：[加入](https://discord.gg/aEB2Ayhu7B) · QQ 群：1125565676 --- ## Package notes This product Bundle combines BotHarness Core (`@botharness/core`), Client (`@botharness/ui`), Browser (`@botharness/browser`), Computer (`@botharness/computer`) and the independently versioned, qualified IM Provider (`@botharness/im-provider`, maintained from [dsh-im](https://github.com/xmanrui/dsh-im) under its MIT license). The Provider updates with the product, without an independent upstream auto-update. Browser and Computer ship present but gated: each Bot still needs its own Browser/Computer Access, and IM accounts start disconnected until you add app credentials in Settings → IM bots. If an existing Profile enables standalone `@xmanrui/dsh-im` or `@botharness/im-provider` as another Bundle, remove that separate Bundle before enabling DeepSeekBot. Formerly separate `@botharness/browser`, `@botharness/computer`, `@botharness/core` or `@botharness/ui` entries migrate into this Bundle automatically on update. Removing a Bundle keeps its stored account configuration and credentials; revalidate the retained Bot bindings and group authorization afterwards. The Bot Browser runs headless by default; a Host that needs the visible window (one-time Human login) overrides `headless` in a later Patch layer or Settings. MIT © BotHarness
# DeepSeekBot **中文** ｜ [English](README.en.md) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/deepseekbot?style=flat-square&color=3d5afe&label=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/deepseekbot) [![MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-71964a?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/built_for-DeepSeek_Harness-b8702f?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) **DeepSeekBot（DSB）：开源的 GrokBot 平替。一组有各自身份、人格和记忆的 bots，一起做事。** [官网](https://deepseekbot.app) · [宣传片](#video) · [安装](#install) · [能力](#features) · [版本亮点](#releases) · [与 DS Bot 的区别](#deepseek-bot-projects) · [社区](#community) · [文档](https://deepseekbot.app/docs/overview/)
## 宣传片 3 分钟看懂 DeepSeekBot：一组有身份、人格和记忆的 bots，在小镇里一起做事。点击封面即可播放。

DeepSeekBot（简称 **DSB**，是 DeepSeekBot 的缩写，才不是“大啥比”，哼）是 BotHarness 开发的 MIT 开源 GrokBot 平替，作为插件运行在 [DeepSeek Harness（DSH）](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)里。你可以创建几个分别负责研究、写作或写代码的 Bot，像和同事一样私聊、拉群、派活；它们记得你，会按时做事，还能在 Slack、Discord、飞书 / Lark、QQ 和微信里以自己的身份回你消息。 模型用你在 DSH 里配置的服务商和额度；Bot 需要在后台持续工作时，运行 DSH 的电脑要保持在线。它和名字很像的 DS Bot（npm `ds-bot`）是两个独立项目，区别见[下文](#deepseek-bot-projects)。 ## 安装 在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端点「插件 → 添加插件」，输入 `deepseekbot@1.4.1`，安装并启用，侧栏就会出现「Bot 模式」。还没装 DSH？先[下载桌面端](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/)。 命令行安装、版本说明和常见问题见[官网安装指南](https://deepseekbot.app/docs/installation/)。 ## 能用它做什么 | 你想要 | DeepSeekBot 怎么帮你 | | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | **一支自己的 AI 小团队** | 创建研究员、设计师、工程师等 Bot，每个都有名字、人格和像素头像，换个对话也还是同一个它。 | | **让 Bot 记住你** | Bot 会记下你的偏好和项目背景，下次直接接着干；记忆随时能翻看、纠正，也能同步到别的电脑。 | | **多个 Bot 一起干活** | 把 Bot 拉进群聊，需要谁就 @ 谁；大一点的任务可以交给 Bot 单独去做，做完交回报告，需要你拍板时会提醒你。 | | **在常用的聊天软件里找它** | 把 Bot 接入 Slack、Discord、飞书 / Lark、QQ 和微信，在群里 @ 它或私聊，它就在原处用自己的身份回复；微信私聊里还能收发文件。 | | **定时做事** | 说一句「每天早上 9 点给我发日志摘要」，Bot 就自己建好定时任务；也可以手动设置每隔几分钟、几小时或每天执行。 | | **帮你操作电脑和浏览器** | 授权后，Bot 可以打开网页、点击、输入、截图，或操作一台共享桌面；你能实时看着它做，随时暂停。 | | **一键装别人做好的 Bot** | 在 [Bot 市场](https://deepseekbot.app/market)浏览、安装别人分享的 Bot，也能把自己的 Bot 分享出去，或打包成 zip 发给朋友。 | | **知道每次更新了什么** | 升级后会告诉你这一版新增了什么；在设置里就能检查并一键更新。 | ### 像素头像 每个 Bot 都有一张由名字生成的像素头像，工作时还会变成它正在用的工具。想自己捏一个？到[官网头像工坊](https://deepseekbot.app/avatar)输入名字试试，还能下载高清头像。 ## 截图

Bot 私聊与记忆演化：Mira 从记忆里找出访客统计；右侧能看到它记忆的每次提交和分支。
群聊协作：@ 三个 Bot，它们各自回复，Nova 读完前两位再接话。

定时任务：一句话让 Bot 自己建任务。
Bot 市场：按话题和关键词找 Bot，点「安装」就多一位同事（图中为示例数据）。

首页与托布：面板可以并排摆放；问托布一句，它就汇报所有 Bot 的状态。
界面设置：主题、配色、壁纸库和半透明面板，只保存在这台设备上。
_截图来自隔离的本地 DSH，对话是虚构的天文台展览示例。_ ## 看得见的记忆 每个 Bot 的记忆就是一个普通的 Git 仓库。你可以在侧栏翻看它记了什么、哪天改了哪几行，觉得不对就直接改；推到 GitHub，就能在几台电脑之间共用同一个 Bot。详见[记忆演化指南](https://deepseekbot.app/docs/channel-sidebar/memory-evolution/)。 ## 版本亮点 完整记录见[官网更新日志](https://deepseekbot.app/changelog/)。 | 版本 | 新内容 | | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | **[1.4.1](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/releases/tag/v1.4.1)**（2026-10-20） | 第一次进入 Bot 模式时，托布五步带你上手；Bot 模式有自己的**主题、半透明面板和壁纸库**；`/compact` 和空闲压缩让长对话保持轻快；快速搜索直达任意设置项；记忆里能预览图片和 Markdown；手机端 Beta 加了通知开关。 | | **[1.4.0](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/releases/tag/v1.4.0)**（2026-10-19） | 首页迎来管家**托布**，用聊天就能管理 Bot、模型和群；桌面端换成可自由拖放的**面板工作区**，每个频道记住自己的布局；审批可交给审核模型；可以配对手机；命令行覆盖了几乎所有界面操作。支持 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 到 0.2.x。 | | **[1.3.1](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/releases/tag/v1.3.1)**（2026-10-14） | 从插件页安装 `deepseekbot` 重新只要一步，不再要求批准构建；需要 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2。`deepseekbot` 命令行可以配置 Host、操作 Bot 的浏览器和 Computer、管理 IM 应用；浏览器面板实时刷新。 | | **[1.3.0](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/releases/tag/v1.3.0)**（2026-10-14） | 界面换上统一的设计系统，Channel 设置收进对话框；Orchestrator 自己整理收件箱和任务；Bot 可以凭你批准使用密钥跑命令行和 **MCP**，一句话就能配好 MCP；消息可多选**导出**；新增 Bot 主题色、更多像素物种和自绘部件；记忆可回到任意版本。需要 DSH 0.2.0 及以上。 | | **[1.2.1](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/releases/tag/v1.2.1)**（2026-10-12） | 修复部分 DSH 版本装不上的问题；群头像显示成员头像拼图；音频和文件附件可以直接播放、下载。 | | **[1.2.0](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/blob/v1.2.0/CHANGELOG.zh.md#120---2026-10-08)**（2026-10-08） | 可以置顶在桌面的像素**窗口伙伴**；绑定一个应用就能在飞书、Slack、Discord、微信里收发消息；Bot 可以**导入导出**成 zip；Bot 资料页加了横幅和简介。 | | **1.1.0**（2026-10-06） | **定时任务**；每次对话都带上 Bot 的人格和核心记忆；设置里**一键更新**；微信支持语音转文字和图片。 | | **1.0.1**（2026-10-05） | 首个正式版：有身份的 PersonaBots、Git 记忆、群聊、任务委派、像素头像、IM 接入和首版 **Bot 市场**。 | ## DeepSeekBot（DSB）与 DS Bot（ds-bot）：两个项目，不同重心 名字很像，但这是两个独立的开源项目：都运行在 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）上，都不是 DeepSeek 公司官方产品。 - **DeepSeekBot（DSB）**，即本仓库，由 BotHarness 维护：让每个 Bot 成为一位能**走出 DSH 窗口**的长期同事。重心是可审阅的 Git 记忆、Bot 自己的飞书 / Slack / Discord / 微信身份、定时任务、任务委派和 Bot 市场。 - **DS Bot**，即 [Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot](https://github.com/Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot)（npm `ds-bot`，项目 README 中也写作 DeepSeek Bot）：把 **DSH 本身变成一个 Bot 聊天应用**。重心是由主 Bot「Chief」通过对话带你建好团队、群管理员默认统筹回复以控制 token 消耗，以及按时间、Bot 和模型查看用量。 | | DeepSeekBot（DSB） | DS Bot（ds-bot） | | ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- | | 仓库 | [BotHarness/DeepSeekBot](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot) | [Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot](https://github.com/Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot) | | 安装包 | npm [`deepseekbot`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/deepseekbot) | npm [`ds-bot`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/ds-bot) | | 许可 | MIT | Apache-2.0 | | 记忆 | 每个 Bot 一个 Git 工作树：文件、commit、diff，可推到 GitHub 在多台机器共享 | Markdown 记忆，每轮后自动审查；个人与团队两级 | | 多 Bot 协作 | Group 中需要谁就 @ 谁；Assignments 委派独立任务并保留报告 | 主 Bot 管理团队；群管理员默认回复，再按需叫其他 Bot | | DSH 之外 | Bot 以自己的身份进入飞书 / Lark、Slack、Discord、微信 | 提供 GitHub connector | | 其他 | 定时任务、Bot 市场、Bot 导入导出、像素头像 | 定时任务、Usage 用量页 | **怎么选**：想让 Bot 在 IM 里以自己的身份工作、想用 Git 审阅和同步记忆，试试 DeepSeekBot；想在 DSH 里由主 Bot 一步步带着建团队、关注 token 用量，试试 DS Bot。两者都开源，欢迎都去读读源码：[DeepSeekBot](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot) · [DS Bot](https://github.com/Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot)。更详细的对比见[官网文章](https://deepseekbot.app/blog/deepseekbot-vs-ds-bot/)。 ## 常见问题 ### 这是哪个 DeepSeek Bot 项目？ 这里是 **BotHarness 的 DeepSeekBot（DSB）**：安装包为 [`deepseekbot`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/deepseekbot)，官网为 [deepseekbot.app](https://deepseekbot.app)。DS Bot 使用 `ds-bot`，是另一个独立项目，不是本产品的简称或旧版本，区别见[上文](#deepseek-bot-projects)。 ### DeepSeekBot 只能使用 DeepSeek 模型吗？ 不是。它使用 DSH 中配置的模型提供商；能否接入取决于接口支持、模型配置与凭据。Bot 的记忆和聊天记录保存在自己的宿主，调用远程模型时相关上下文仍会发给所选服务商。 ## 开发者 想从源码运行或参与开发：需要 Node ≥22 和 pnpm。 ```bash git clone https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot.git BotHarness cd BotHarness pnpm install && pnpm build node scripts/dev-instance.mjs --home /tmp/botharness-demo --port 31967 ``` 更多见[本地实例指南](docs/client-bridge.md#7-本地开发环路dsh-020-rc1) · [贡献指南](CONTRIBUTING.zh.md) · [架构](docs/architecture/botharness-architecture.md) · [架构决策](docs/adr/) · [Agent 开发规范](AGENTS.md) · [Release Ledger](CHANGELOG.zh.md) · [DSH 官方文档](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/)。 真实 IM 测试可用[共享 QA 应用向导](docs/agents/im-test-apps.md)配置 Lark、Slack、Discord 的独立 QA1／QA2／QA3；例如运行 `node scripts/dev-im-test-apps.mjs setup discord`，隐藏输入 Token，并在每次启动接收端前确认当前独占窗口。 ## 仓库状态 **最近 30 天**：关闭 PR 包含已合并 PR；提交按默认分支所有可达历史统计，包含合并提交和机器人提交。每六小时更新，图中时间为最后成功更新时间。 [文字数据与统计口径](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/tree/readme-status#readme) · [JSON](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/readme-status/stats.json) · [更新任务](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/actions/workflows/readme-status.yml) ## # DeepSeekBot **中文** ｜ [English](README.en.md) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/deepseekbot?style=flat-square&color=3d5afe&label=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/deepseekbot) [![MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-71964a?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/built_for-DeepSeek_Harness-b8702f?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) **DeepSeekBot（DSB）：开源的 GrokBot 平替。一组有各自身份、人格和记忆的 bots，一起做事。** [官网](https://deepseekbot.app) · [宣传片](#video) · [安装](#install) · [能力](#features) · [版本亮点](#releases) · [与 DS Bot 的区别](#deepseek-bot-projects) · [社区](#community) · [文档](https://deepseekbot.app/docs/overview/)
## 宣传片 3 分钟看懂 DeepSeekBot：一组有身份、人格和记忆的 bots，在小镇里一起做事。点击封面即可播放。

DeepSeekBot（简称 **DSB**，是 DeepSeekBot 的缩写，才不是“大啥比”，哼）是 BotHarness 开发的 MIT 开源 GrokBot 平替，作为插件运行在 [DeepSeek Harness（DSH）](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)里。你可以创建几个分别负责研究、写作或写代码的 Bot，像和同事一样私聊、拉群、派活；它们记得你，会按时做事，还能在 Slack、Discord、飞书 / Lark、QQ 和微信里以自己的身份回你消息。 模型用你在 DSH 里配置的服务商和额度；Bot 需要在后台持续工作时，运行 DSH 的电脑要保持在线。它和名字很像的 DS Bot（npm `ds-bot`）是两个独立项目，区别见[下文](#deepseek-bot-projects)。 ## 安装 在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端点「插件 → 添加插件」，输入 `deepseekbot@1.4.1`，安装并启用，侧栏就会出现「Bot 模式」。还没装 DSH？先[下载桌面端](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/)。 命令行安装、版本说明和常见问题见[官网安装指南](https://deepseekbot.app/docs/installation/)。 ## 能用它做什么 | 你想要 | DeepSeekBot 怎么帮你 | | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | **一支自己的 AI 小团队** | 创建研究员、设计师、工程师等 Bot，每个都有名字、人格和像素头像，换个对话也还是同一个它。 | | **让 Bot 记住你** | Bot 会记下你的偏好和项目背景，下次直接接着干；记忆随时能翻看、纠正，也能同步到别的电脑。 | | **多个 Bot 一起干活** | 把 Bot 拉进群聊，需要谁就 @ 谁；大一点的任务可以交给 Bot 单独去做，做完交回报告，需要你拍板时会提醒你。 | | **在常用的聊天软件里找它** | 把 Bot 接入 Slack、Discord、飞书 / Lark、QQ 和微信，在群里 @ 它或私聊，它就在原处用自己的身份回复；微信私聊里还能收发文件。 | | **定时做事** | 说一句「每天早上 9 点给我发日志摘要」，Bot 就自己建好定时任务；也可以手动设置每隔几分钟、几小时或每天执行。 | | **帮你操作电脑和浏览器** | 授权后，Bot 可以打开网页、点击、输入、截图，或操作一台共享桌面；你能实时看着它做，随时暂停。 | | **一键装别人做好的 Bot** | 在 [Bot 市场](https://deepseekbot.app/market)浏览、安装别人分享的 Bot，也能把自己的 Bot 分享出去，或打包成 zip 发给朋友。 | | **知道每次更新了什么** | 升级后会告诉你这一版新增了什么；在设置里就能检查并一键更新。 | ### 像素头像 每个 Bot 都有一张由名字生成的像素头像，工作时还会变成它正在用的工具。想自己捏一个？到[官网头像工坊](https://deepseekbot.app/avatar)输入名字试试，还能下载高清头像。 ## 截图

Bot 私聊与记忆演化：Mira 从记忆里找出访客统计；右侧能看到它记忆的每次提交和分支。
群聊协作：@ 三个 Bot，它们各自回复，Nova 读完前两位再接话。

定时任务：一句话让 Bot 自己建任务。
Bot 市场：按话题和关键词找 Bot，点「安装」就多一位同事（图中为示例数据）。

首页与托布：面板可以并排摆放；问托布一句，它就汇报所有 Bot 的状态。
界面设置：主题、配色、壁纸库和半透明面板，只保存在这台设备上。
_截图来自隔离的本地 DSH，对话是虚构的天文台展览示例。_ ## 看得见的记忆 每个 Bot 的记忆就是一个普通的 Git 仓库。你可以在侧栏翻看它记了什么、哪天改了哪几行，觉得不对就直接改；推到 GitHub，就能在几台电脑之间共用同一个 Bot。详见[记忆演化指南](https://deepseekbot.app/docs/channel-sidebar/memory-evolution/)。 ## DeepSeekBot（DSB）与 DS Bot（ds-bot）：两个项目，不同重心 名字很像，但这是两个独立的开源项目：都运行在 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）上，都不是 DeepSeek 公司官方产品。 - **DeepSeekBot（DSB）**，即本仓库，由 BotHarness 维护：让每个 Bot 成为一位能**走出 DSH 窗口**的长期同事。重心是可审阅的 Git 记忆、Bot 自己的飞书 / Slack / Discord / 微信身份、定时任务、任务委派和 Bot 市场。 - **DS Bot**，即 [Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot](https://github.com/Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot)（npm `ds-bot`，项目 README 中也写作 DeepSeek Bot）：把 **DSH 本身变成一个 Bot 聊天应用**。重心是由主 Bot「Chief」通过对话带你建好团队、群管理员默认统筹回复以控制 token 消耗，以及按时间、Bot 和模型查看用量。 | | DeepSeekBot（DSB） | DS Bot（ds-bot） | | ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- | | 仓库 | [BotHarness/DeepSeekBot](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot) | [Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot](https://github.com/Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot) | | 安装包 | npm [`deepseekbot`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/deepseekbot) | npm [`ds-bot`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/ds-bot) | | 许可 | MIT | Apache-2.0 | | 记忆 | 每个 Bot 一个 Git 工作树：文件、commit、diff，可推到 GitHub 在多台机器共享 | Markdown 记忆，每轮后自动审查；个人与团队两级 | | 多 Bot 协作 | Group 中需要谁就 @ 谁；Assignments 委派独立任务并保留报告 | 主 Bot 管理团队；群管理员默认回复，再按需叫其他 Bot | | DSH 之外 | Bot 以自己的身份进入飞书 / Lark、Slack、Discord、微信 | 提供 GitHub connector | | 其他 | 定时任务、Bot 市场、Bot 导入导出、像素头像 | 定时任务、Usage 用量页 | **怎么选**：想让 Bot 在 IM 里以自己的身份工作、想用 Git 审阅和同步记忆，试试 DeepSeekBot；想在 DSH 里由主 Bot 一步步带着建团队、关注 token 用量，试试 DS Bot。两者都开源，欢迎都去读读源码：[DeepSeekBot](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot) · [DS Bot](https://github.com/Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot)。更详细的对比见[官网文章](https://deepseekbot.app/blog/deepseekbot-vs-ds-bot/)。 ## 仓库状态 **最近 30 天**：关闭 PR 包含已合并 PR；提交按默认分支所有可达历史统计，包含合并提交和机器人提交。每六小时更新，图中时间为最后成功更新时间。 [文字数据与统计口径](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/tree/readme-status#readme) · [JSON](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/readme-status/stats.json) · [更新任务](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/actions/workflows/readme-status.yml) ## # @botharness/vrm-companion A VRM companion Panel for [DeepSeekBot](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot): the Bot's character sits at a desk in a lo-fi study room in the style of Chill with You. It types while the Bot works, looks up while it thinks, turns to you and speaks the Bot's committed replies in a speech bubble, and between tasks sips coffee, rests its chin or checks its phone. Day, night and weather follow your local clock, and **Change character…** loads your own `.vrm` file (VRoid/VRM 0.x or VRM 1.0) without uploading it. ## Requirements - DeepSeek Harness (DSH) `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0`. - DeepSeekBot newer than 1.4.1, installed in the same Profile. The Panel uses DeepSeekBot's `botPresentation` and `dockPanels` services, which 1.4.1 and earlier do not provide, and the DSH Client `locale` service for its Chinese and English text; the Panel does not load without them. ## Install ```sh dsh plugin --profile add @botharness/vrm-companion@0.2.0 ``` Restart the Host. In Bot mode, select a Bot DM, open Messages and choose **VRM Companion** (**VRM 伴侣** in Chinese) in the Messages header. The pin icon creates a fixed instance for that Bot. See the [Panel guide](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/blob/main/docs/panel-plugin.md) for controls and behavior. ## License The source code is MIT; see [LICENSE](LICENSE). The bundled assets keep their own terms: - The default character, VRoid Project's AvatarSample_A, may be used, modified and redistributed without credit under its VRoid Hub conditions; it is not under the MIT license. See [assets/README.md](assets/README.md). - The room models are KayKit Furniture Bits by Kay Lousberg, CC0; see [assets/kaykit/README.md](assets/kaykit/README.md). - The lilToon shader port is MIT; see [assets/THREE-LILTOON-LICENSE.txt](assets/THREE-LILTOON-LICENSE.txt) and its third-party notices. ## Release `@botharness/vrm-companion` is versioned independently of DeepSeekBot and published by `.github/workflows/vrm-companion-release.yml`. 1. Bump `version` in `packages/vrm-companion/package.json` (a prerelease such as `0.2.0-rc.1` goes to the `next` dist-tag, anything else to `latest`) and merge it to `main`. 2. Tag that commit on `main` and push the tag: ```sh git tag vrm-companion-v0.2.0 && git push origin vrm-companion-v0.2.0 ``` 3. The workflow checks that the tag is on `main` and matches the package version, runs `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `pnpm build` and the VRM tests, then waits for approval in the `npm-release` environment. 4. After approval it runs `npm publish --provenance --access public` in `packages/vrm-companion`. It authenticates with npm trusted publishing when a Trusted Publisher for this workflow is configured on npmjs.com for `@botharness/vrm-companion`, and otherwise with the `NPM_TOKEN` secret.
# DeepSeekBot **中文** ｜ [English](README.en.md) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/deepseekbot?style=flat-square&color=3d5afe&label=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/deepseekbot) [![MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-71964a?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/built_for-DeepSeek_Harness-b8702f?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) **DeepSeekBot（DSB）：开源的 GrokBot 平替。一组有各自身份、人格和记忆的 bots，一起做事。** [官网](https://deepseekbot.app) · [宣传片](#video) · [安装](#install) · [能力](#features) · [版本亮点](#releases) · [与 DS Bot 的区别](#deepseek-bot-projects) · [社区](#community) · [文档](https://deepseekbot.app/docs/overview/)
## 宣传片 3 分钟看懂 DeepSeekBot：一组有身份、人格和记忆的 bots，在小镇里一起做事。点击封面即可播放。

DeepSeekBot（简称 **DSB**，是 DeepSeekBot 的缩写，才不是“大啥比”，哼）是 BotHarness 开发的 MIT 开源 GrokBot 平替，作为插件运行在 [DeepSeek Harness（DSH）](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)里。你可以创建几个分别负责研究、写作或写代码的 Bot，像和同事一样私聊、拉群、派活；它们记得你，会按时做事，还能在 Slack、Discord、飞书 / Lark、QQ 和微信里以自己的身份回你消息。 模型用你在 DSH 里配置的服务商和额度；Bot 需要在后台持续工作时，运行 DSH 的电脑要保持在线。它和名字很像的 DS Bot（npm `ds-bot`）是两个独立项目，区别见[下文](#deepseek-bot-projects)。 ## 安装 在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端点「插件 → 添加插件」，输入 `deepseekbot@1.4.1`，安装并启用，侧栏就会出现「Bot 模式」。还没装 DSH？先[下载桌面端](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/)。 命令行安装、版本说明和常见问题见[官网安装指南](https://deepseekbot.app/docs/installation/)。 ## 能用它做什么 | 你想要 | DeepSeekBot 怎么帮你 | | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | **一支自己的 AI 小团队** | 创建研究员、设计师、工程师等 Bot，每个都有名字、人格和像素头像，换个对话也还是同一个它。 | | **让 Bot 记住你** | Bot 会记下你的偏好和项目背景，下次直接接着干；记忆随时能翻看、纠正，也能同步到别的电脑。 | | **多个 Bot 一起干活** | 把 Bot 拉进群聊，需要谁就 @ 谁；大一点的任务可以交给 Bot 单独去做，做完交回报告，需要你拍板时会提醒你。 | | **在常用的聊天软件里找它** | 把 Bot 接入 Slack、Discord、飞书 / Lark、QQ 和微信，在群里 @ 它或私聊，它就在原处用自己的身份回复；微信私聊里还能收发文件。 | | **定时做事** | 说一句「每天早上 9 点给我发日志摘要」，Bot 就自己建好定时任务；也可以手动设置每隔几分钟、几小时或每天执行。 | | **帮你操作电脑和浏览器** | 授权后，Bot 可以打开网页、点击、输入、截图，或操作一台共享桌面；你能实时看着它做，随时暂停。 | | **一键装别人做好的 Bot** | 在 [Bot 市场](https://deepseekbot.app/market)浏览、安装别人分享的 Bot，也能把自己的 Bot 分享出去，或打包成 zip 发给朋友。 | | **知道每次更新了什么** | 升级后会告诉你这一版新增了什么；在设置里就能检查并一键更新。 | ### 像素头像 每个 Bot 都有一张由名字生成的像素头像，工作时还会变成它正在用的工具。想自己捏一个？到[官网头像工坊](https://deepseekbot.app/avatar)输入名字试试，还能下载高清头像。 ## 截图

Bot 私聊与记忆演化：Mira 从记忆里找出访客统计；右侧能看到它记忆的每次提交和分支。
群聊协作：@ 三个 Bot，它们各自回复，Nova 读完前两位再接话。

定时任务：一句话让 Bot 自己建任务。
Bot 市场：按话题和关键词找 Bot，点「安装」就多一位同事（图中为示例数据）。

首页与托布：面板可以并排摆放；问托布一句，它就汇报所有 Bot 的状态。
界面设置：主题、配色、壁纸库和半透明面板，只保存在这台设备上。

## 宣传片 3 分钟看懂 DeepSeekBot：一组有身份、人格和记忆的 bots，在小镇里一起做事。点击封面即可播放。

DeepSeekBot（简称 **DSB**，是 DeepSeekBot 的缩写，才不是“大啥比”，哼）是 BotHarness 开发的 MIT 开源 GrokBot 平替，作为插件运行在 [DeepSeek Harness（DSH）](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)里。你可以创建几个分别负责研究、写作或写代码的 Bot，像和同事一样私聊、拉群、派活；它们记得你，会按时做事，还能在 Slack、Discord、飞书 / Lark、QQ 和微信里以自己的身份回你消息。 模型用你在 DSH 里配置的服务商和额度；Bot 需要在后台持续工作时，运行 DSH 的电脑要保持在线。它和名字很像的 DS Bot（npm `ds-bot`）是两个独立项目，区别见[下文](#deepseek-bot-projects)。 ## 安装 在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端点「插件 → 添加插件」，输入 `deepseekbot@1.4.1`，安装并启用，侧栏就会出现「Bot 模式」。还没装 DSH？先[下载桌面端](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/)。 命令行安装、版本说明和常见问题见[官网安装指南](https://deepseekbot.app/docs/installation/)。 ## 能用它做什么 | 你想要 | DeepSeekBot 怎么帮你 | | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | **一支自己的 AI 小团队** | 创建研究员、设计师、工程师等 Bot，每个都有名字、人格和像素头像，换个对话也还是同一个它。 | | **让 Bot 记住你** | Bot 会记下你的偏好和项目背景，下次直接接着干；记忆随时能翻看、纠正，也能同步到别的电脑。 | | **多个 Bot 一起干活** | 把 Bot 拉进群聊，需要谁就 @ 谁；大一点的任务可以交给 Bot 单独去做，做完交回报告，需要你拍板时会提醒你。 | | **在常用的聊天软件里找它** | 把 Bot 接入 Slack、Discord、飞书 / Lark、QQ 和微信，在群里 @ 它或私聊，它就在原处用自己的身份回复；微信私聊里还能收发文件。 | | **定时做事** | 说一句「每天早上 9 点给我发日志摘要」，Bot 就自己建好定时任务；也可以手动设置每隔几分钟、几小时或每天执行。 | | **帮你操作电脑和浏览器** | 授权后，Bot 可以打开网页、点击、输入、截图，或操作一台共享桌面；你能实时看着它做，随时暂停。 | | **一键装别人做好的 Bot** | 在 [Bot 市场](https://deepseekbot.app/market)浏览、安装别人分享的 Bot，也能把自己的 Bot 分享出去，或打包成 zip 发给朋友。 | | **知道每次更新了什么** | 升级后会告诉你这一版新增了什么；在设置里就能检查并一键更新。 | ### 像素头像 每个 Bot 都有一张由名字生成的像素头像，工作时还会变成它正在用的工具。想自己捏一个？到[官网头像工坊](https://deepseekbot.app/avatar)输入名字试试，还能下载高清头像。 ## 截图

Bot 私聊与记忆演化：Mira 从记忆里找出访客统计；右侧能看到它记忆的每次提交和分支。
群聊协作：@ 三个 Bot，它们各自回复，Nova 读完前两位再接话。

定时任务：一句话让 Bot 自己建任务。
Bot 市场：按话题和关键词找 Bot，点「安装」就多一位同事（图中为示例数据）。

首页与托布：面板可以并排摆放；问托布一句，它就汇报所有 Bot 的状态。

# DSH Keys Manager

[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-keys-manager)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-keys-manager)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%5E22.19%20%7C%7C%20%3E%3D24-339933)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-keys-manager)
[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%5E0.2.1--rc.2-0969DA)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm)

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns one provider API key into a managed pool.
It extends the Models page rather than replacing it: providers, models, and the
model picker stay where they are; only the API-key source moves behind the
manager.

## Features

- Several keys per provider, each with an alias and health state.
- One key pinned to a session, with round-robin selection for new sessions.
- Bounded retry on the same key, then automatic failover to another key.
- Exponential cooldown recovery, capped at seven days.
- A search-driven Keys Manager page on the plugin's own detail page.
- A "managed by Keys Manager" badge inside the existing Models provider cards.
- Extra built-in providers installed as ordinary `llm-pi-ai` routes.
- OAuth account sign-in for seven pi-ai-backed providers, stored beside
  the API keys.
- A companion transport component for providers the vendored pi-ai cannot
  speak — Cursor (`cursor`) today — installed with the plugin.

### Extra providers

This catalog of 35 extra providers comes from
[oh-my-pi](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi)'s provider catalog (MIT).

<details>
<summary>All 35 extra providers</summary>

| Provider | Route id | API key env |
|---|---|---|
| DeepInfra | `deepinfra` | `DEEPINFRA_API_KEY` |
| Novita | `novita` | `NOVITA_API_KEY` |
| StepFun | `stepfun` | `STEPFUN_API_KEY` |
| SambaNova | `sambanova` | `SAMBANOVA_API_KEY` |
| Qianfan | `qianfan` | `QIANFAN_API_KEY` |
| GMI Cloud | `gmi-cloud` | `GMI_API_KEY` |
| Synthetic | `synthetic` | `SYNTHETIC_API_KEY` |
| ZenMux | `zenmux` | `ZENMUX_API_KEY` |
| Kilo Gateway | `kilo` | `KILO_API_KEY` |
| NanoGPT | `nanogpt` | `NANO_GPT_API_KEY` |
| Venice AI | `venice` | `VENICE_API_KEY` |
| AIML API | `aimlapi` | `AIMLAPI_API_KEY` |
| AI& | `aiand` | `AIAND_API_KEY` |
| Helmcode | `helmcode` | `HELMCODE_API_KEY` |
| Alibaba Coding Plan | `alibaba-coding-plan` | `ALIBABA_CODING_PLAN_API_KEY` |
| MiniMax Coding (Global) | `minimax-code` | `MINIMAX_CODE_API_KEY` |
| MiniMax Coding (CN) | `minimax-code-cn` | `MINIMAX_CODE_CN_API_KEY` |
| Umans AI Coding Plan | `umans` | `UMANS_AI_CODING_PLAN_API_KEY` |
| Sakana AI | `sakana` | `SAKANA_API_KEY` |
| CoralBricks | `coralbricks` | `CORAL_API_KEY` |
| Wafer Serverless | `wafer-serverless` | `WAFER_SERVERLESS_API_KEY` |
| Alibaba Token Plan | `alibaba-token-plan` | `ALIBABA_TOKEN_PLAN_API_KEY` |
| Alibaba Token Plan (CN) | `alibaba-token-plan-cn` | `BAILIAN_TOKEN_PLAN_API_KEY` |
| Charm Hyper | `charm-hyper` | `CHARM_HYPER_API_KEY`, `HYPER_API_KEY` |
| LiteLLM Proxy | `litellm` | `LITELLM_API_KEY` |
| SiliconFlow | `siliconflow` | `SILICONFLOW_API_KEY` |
| SiliconFlow (CN) | `siliconflow-cn` | `SILICONFLOW_CN_API_KEY` |
| Zhipu Coding Plan | `zhipu-coding-plan` | `ZHIPU_API_KEY` |
| Abliteration | `abliteration` | `ABLITERATION_API_KEY`, `ABLIT_KEY` |
| ClinePass | `cline-pass` | `CLINE_API_KEY` |
| Command Code | `commandcode` | `COMMAND_CODE_API_KEY`, `COMMANDCODE_API_KEY` |
| CoreWeave Serverless Inference | `coreweave` | `COREWEAVE_API_KEY` |
| Fire Pass | `firepass` | `FIREPASS_API_KEY` |
| Ollama Cloud | `ollama-cloud` | `OLLAMA_CLOUD_API_KEY` |
| Yolo Auto | `yolo-auto` | `YOLO_AUTO_API_KEY` |

Where two variables are listed, either is accepted; the first is the primary.

CoreWeave Serverless Inference also needs `COREWEAVE_PROJECT=<team>/<project>` in the DSH process environment before it is added.

</details>

## Quick start

### Install — DeepSeek Harness Desktop / Web

In the DeepSeek Harness Desktop or Web app, open **Plugins**, click
**Add plugin**, enter `dsh-keys-manager` in the package field, and click
**Install**. When the install finishes, choose **Enable now** so the plugin is
switched on.

Through the wizard, the app installs the same published npm package as the
CLI path below, already carrying its built bundle. Refresh the DeepSeek
Harness page afterwards so the browser half is fetched.

### Install — published package

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-keys-manager
```

Installing `dsh-keys-manager` installs two bundle components. The published
package depends on `dsh-llm-omp-transports`, so one install resolves both npm
packages, and the plugin page lists both `dsh-keys-manager` and
`llm-omp-transports`. Enable both: the manager owns credentials and routing,
the transport component owns the Cursor wire protocol.

### Install — local checkout

```sh
git clone https://github.com/btspoony/dsh-keys-manager
cd dsh-keys-manager
pnpm i
dsh plugin --profile web link .
```

The two CLI paths differ in where the build output comes from: `dsh plugin
--profile web add dsh-keys-manager` installs the published npm tarball, which
ships the built `lib/` and the client bundle. The local
`dsh plugin --profile web link .` path runs `prepare` during `pnpm i`, which
builds `lib/` and the client bundle, so the clone flow above includes that
build step; `prepack` builds the same output when the package is packed or
published.

Refresh the Web page after installing so the browser half is fetched.

## Usage

Open **Plugins → Keys Manager → View** (rendered as
`Plugins → 密钥管理 → 查看` in the Chinese locale). The manager renders on the
plugin's detail page, between its description and its included rows, matching
the shipped plugin configuration cards.

1. Search for a provider. Existing DSH providers appear first; the plugin also
   ships the curated extra catalog described above.
2. Adopt a provider. For an existing provider the manager imports the
   currently resolved credential, writes a broker reference into the provider
   profile, and leaves the original key in the credential store so release can
   restore it.
3. Add more keys with an alias. Every key is stored in the Harness credential
   store under its own reference; the manager state document never contains a
   key literal.
4. Manage a key from the three-dot menu: rename, pause/resume, delete. A key
   row shows status, last use, and the recovery time while cooling.
5. Tune retry count (1–3), base cooldown, and recovery grace in the settings
   card.

### OAuth accounts

Providers that ship a native OAuth sign-in offer two ways to join the pool:
**Add key** stores a static API key, while **Add account** runs the
provider's OAuth sign-in flow and stores the resulting grant as an account
row in the same pool.

Supported providers — the seven whose OAuth flows `llm-pi-ai` implements:
Anthropic, GitHub Copilot, Kimi Coding, OpenAI Codex, OpenRouter, Radius,
and xAI.

The increment-1 model is honest about scope: **API keys form the selection
ring** — sticky sessions, round-robin, retry failover, and cooldowns
operate across the provider's API keys — while **one projected OAuth grant
serves its provider**: the account whose grant is projected answers
requests directly, and one active grant per provider is kept. Per-account
ranking (rotating or load-balancing between accounts) is future work. An
account row's counters reflect that account's own successes and failures,
not a per-account traffic split. When the projected grant fails (expired
or refresh rejected), the account cools down. On a key-capable route the
pool falls back to the provider's key pool; an OAuth-only route has no
API-key pool and stops serving requests until an account is signed in
again. Recovery is a manual re-login from the account menu.

Adding an account stores only the provider-issued grant in the Harness
credential store, behind the account's `grantRef`; the manager state keeps
the reference plus non-sensitive metadata (email, account id, expiry) — the
same secret-free layout as API keys.

### Cursor transport

Cursor is served by the companion `dsh-llm-omp-transports` component on its
own `cursor` route. It does not run through the pi-ai key pool: the route
keeps exactly one grant at `llm-omp-transports/cursor`, refreshed
automatically on the credential seam.

- Models come from the pinned `@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog@18.12.3` table (123 rows),
  generated into the transport at build time. The route streams text and
  reasoning, and hands tool calls to DSH's tool loop.
- Sign in from the **Transport accounts** section of the Keys Manager page: a
  browser page plus a poll. The row shows identity, expiry and status; after an
  expired or rejected grant, re-login is manual.
- Images are not forwarded yet. The route advertises text-only input and
  refuses image blocks with a typed error instead of dropping them.
- The client is unofficial and presents Cursor's vendor-internal OAuth
  identity. Read the [transports package docs](packages/llm-omp/README.md)
  before relying on it; the risks and limits are listed there.

### Selection and failure policy

- **Sticky session**: the first request of a session selects a key and binds
  it for that session/provider pair. Later requests reuse it.
- **Round robin**: a new session advances the provider cursor and takes the
  next healthy key.
- **Retry**: a failing request is retried on the same key `retryCount` times.
- **Switch**: after the retry budget is spent, the failing key is marked
  cooling, and the session is rebound to another healthy key.
- **Cooldown**: the first failure cools a key for `baseCooldownMs`. A failure
  while cooling, or within `recoveryGraceMs` after recovery, doubles the
  next cooldown. A long healthy gap resets the escalation. The hard cap is
  seven days.
- **Recovery**: the key is automatically selectable again when its cooldown
  expires; no manual reset is required.
- **Delegation**: request-shaped failures such as
  `CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED` and cancellation never cool a key. When no
  alternate key exists, the manager delegates to the composition's normal
  retry/fallback policy.

## Configuration & data

Manager metadata lives at:

```text
$DSH_HOME/keys-manager/state.json
```

with owner-only permissions. It contains aliases, credential references,
health counters, session bindings, and provider adoption facts. API key
literals live only in the Harness credential store. The file is written
atomically through a temporary file and a rename.

Each managed provider profile points its `apiKeyEnv` at a broker reference
such as `KEYSMGR_ZAI_CODING_CN_3FA2C1`. The Host credential layer answers that
reference per request with the session's selected key. The Models page sees
the profile as configured; writing directly to the broker reference is
refused with a pointer to the manager.

### OAuth2 extension point

The state shape already distinguishes `kind: "api-key"` from `kind: "oauth"`
and keeps a nullable `oauth` object beside the credential reference. A future
account flow can add records under `keys-manager/<provider>/<key>` without
rewriting existing rows. Providers whose only authentication is OAuth are
reported as unsupported in this version rather than being treated as API-key
providers.

## Provider classification

Every provider card carries its origin:

- **DSH built-in** (`DSH 内置`) — a route from the shipped DSH pi-ai catalog.
- **Plugin built-in** (`插件内置`) — a route from this plugin's extra catalog
  in `src/providers.ts`.
- **Custom** (`自定义`) — a hand-declared route in the active profile.

The following DSH built-ins are explicitly outside single-key pool management:

| Provider | Why |
|---|---|
| `amazon-bedrock` | AWS credential chain (profile, IAM keys, ECS/IRSA/EC2), not one API key |
| `cloudflare-ai-gateway` | API key plus a Cloudflare account ID and gateway ID |
| `cloudflare-workers-ai` | API key plus a Cloudflare account ID |
| `openai-codex` | ChatGPT OAuth sign-in only; no API-key credential — usable as an [OAuth account](#oauth-accounts) instead of a key |

All other DSH catalog routes expose an API-key credential. Providers that
also support OAuth (Anthropic, GitHub Copilot, Kimi Coding, OpenAI Codex,
OpenRouter, Radius, xAI) remain manageable through their API-key path, and
their OAuth sign-in is available as [OAuth accounts](#oauth-accounts).

## Repository layout

This repository is a pnpm workspace with two published packages:

| Path | npm package | Role |
|---|---|---|
| root | `dsh-keys-manager` | Host plugin, Keys Manager Web client, bundle patch |
| `packages/llm-omp` | `dsh-llm-omp-transports` | Cursor (and future) transport component |

The root package declares the transports package as a dependency, so the
published Keys Manager tarball pulls the transport in rather than vendoring
it. Both packages are released together and carry the same version; see
[Release](docs/release.md).

## Documentation

| Doc | Content |
|---|---|
| [Development](docs/development.md) | build and dev workflow, repository layout |
| [Release](docs/release.md) | CI checks and the npm release flow |
| [Known limits](docs/known-limits.md) | current design boundaries, including deferred providers |
| [Transports package](packages/llm-omp/README.md) | Cursor transport: support status, risks, build/test, release |

Chinese versions: [README.zh-CN.md](README.zh-CN.md) and the `*.zh-CN.md`
files in `docs/` — [开发](docs/development.zh-CN.md) ·
[发布](docs/release.zh-CN.md) · [已知限制](docs/known-limits.zh-CN.md).
Current design boundaries at a glance:
[Known limits](docs/known-limits.md).

## License

# dsh-llm-omp-transports

A DeepSeek Harness LLM transport component for providers whose wire protocols
the vendored `llm-pi-ai` does not speak. It is published from this repository
as `dsh-llm-omp-transports` and installed as a dependency of
`dsh-keys-manager`: installing the Keys Manager plugin brings this component,
and the plugin page lists both bundle components
(`dsh-keys-manager` and `llm-omp-transports`).

| Fact | Value |
|---|---|
| npm package | `dsh-llm-omp-transports` |
| Plugin id | `llm-omp-transports` |
| Route | `cursor` (first provider; the seam is provider-generic) |
| Credential scope | `llm-omp-transports/<provider>`, today `llm-omp-transports/cursor` |
| Runtime | Node 24 (the bundle imports Node builtins only) |
| License | MIT |

The plugin registers its own route on the DSH `llm` seam, so it depends on no
upstream DSH change. `@oh-my-pi/pi-ai` and `@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog` are used at
**build time only**: the build inlines the pinned omp Cursor transport into one
ESM artifact (`lib/omp/cursor.mjs`), and the published package imports nothing
from `@oh-my-pi/*` or `bun:*` at runtime.

## Cursor support status

- **Text streaming** — yes. Assistant text and usage are projected onto DSH's
  `StreamChunk` stream.
- **Reasoning streaming** — yes, with the catalog's effort routing. The
  selected effort becomes the routed wire model id; an effort the model does
  not advertise is refused with `UNSUPPORTED_REASONING_EFFORT`.
- **Tool-call handoff** — yes, through DSH's tool loop. Cursor's server drives
  execution over its exec channel, so the transport runs in external-executor
  mode: an unhandled MCP call is emitted as an unresolved tool call and
  answered with a handoff, DSH runs the tool, and the next request replays the
  result from history. The adapter never executes a tool itself.
- **Sign-in and refresh** — yes. The package registers the
  `llm-omp-transports/cursor` authorization flow (a browser login page plus a
  poll, no loopback callback and no device code) and refreshes an expiring
  grant under the credential store's per-key lock. The Keys Manager Web page's
  **Transport accounts** section is the surface that starts the flow.
- **Models** — from the pinned catalog: the Cursor slice of
  `@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog@18.12.3` (123 rows) is generated into
  `src/catalog/cursor.ts` and served without a network call.
- **Route** — `cursor`, declared configurable so the Models page has a profile
  entry for it.
- **Images** — not yet. The route advertises text-only input and refuses image
  blocks with `CONTENT_UNSUPPORTED`; see [known limits](docs/known-limits.md).

## Hard constraints

- **Pinned, build-time-only omp.** `@oh-my-pi/pi-ai` and `@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog`
  are pinned to `18.12.3` and declared as devDependencies. No runtime package
  may import them: `tests/build.test.ts` checks that every static import of the
  shipped artifact is a Node builtin.
- **Node 24 load.** The artifact is imported through a plain Node ESM loader
  with no Bun global present, and must expose `streamCursor`. The Bun and
  `@oh-my-pi/pi-utils` surface the bundled graph reaches is covered by the
  shims in `scripts/omp-shim/`; a missing shim symbol or a new shim category
  fails the build.
- **Drift gate.** `scripts/omp-manifest.json` records the pinned versions, the
  measured artifact, the shim surface and the hashes of every source the
  transport depends on, plus the shim symbols the esbuild graph actually
  reaches. `tests/build.test.ts` re-checks all of it, and CI asserts the
  committed manifest is unchanged after a build, so an omp bump that changes
  the contract shows up as a reviewable manifest diff before it can reach a
  request.
- **Generated catalog.** The Cursor model table is generated from the pinned
  catalog and is not hand-edited. An omp or catalog bump requires
  `pnpm -C packages/llm-omp run generate:catalog`.

## Limits and risks

- **Unofficial Cursor client.** The transport reuses Cursor's vendor-internal
  OAuth client id and announces a released CLI build through the
  `x-cursor-client-version` / `x-cursor-client-type` request identity. The MIT
  license covers the code, not the service, so relying on this client carries a
  terms-of-service (ToS) risk. If Cursor gates non-IDE clients (a `401`/`403`
  on `Run` with a valid account), this transport stops until the product
  decision recorded as stop condition **S4**.
- **Real endpoints unverified.** The login, poll, refresh and agent endpoint
  shapes are ported from the pinned omp sources; this repository's tests replay
  recorded fixtures and never call Cursor, so live behavior is unverified until
  it is exercised against a real account.
- **In-process checkpoint cache.** Per-conversation checkpoints live in a
  module-level, in-process LRU (128 conversations) inside the bundled omp
  transport. Nothing is persisted: an evicted or lost checkpoint rebuilds from
  the request history, exactly like the first request after a restart, and a
  multi-step tool turn must replay its history.
- **Image input is advertised as text-only.** Forwarding is future work; until
  it lands the projection refuses non-text blocks instead of silently dropping
  them. 100 of the pinned catalog's 123 rows claim image support but are
  advertised text-only.
- **Tool handoff uses DSH's external-executor mode.** A turn that needs a tool
  stops at the handoff; the result is only replayed on the follow-up request.
  Tool declarations travel as MCP definitions, and `toolHistory` is accepted
  but cannot be replayed (the active tool set is the projection).
- **Only MCP calls are handed off.** Cursor-native exec frames (`read`, `shell`,
  `write`, `delete`, `grep`, `ls`, `diagnostics`, streamed edits) are answered
  by the transport with `Tool not available` and are **not** executed by DSH
  (live reachability unverified).
- **Advisory request knobs are ignored.** Cursor's agent protocol has no field
  for an output cap, sampling temperature, stop sequences or an auxiliary-call
  purpose; DSH's `maxTokens`, `temperature`, `stop` and `purpose` never reach
  the wire, and Cursor applies the catalog output limit server-side.

## Develop and test

```sh
pnpm -C packages/llm-omp typecheck
pnpm -C packages/llm-omp build
pnpm -C packages/llm-omp test
pnpm -C packages/llm-omp run generate:catalog
```

`build` bundles the pinned omp graph from `scripts/omp-entry.ts` into
`lib/omp/cursor.mjs` and rewrites `scripts/omp-manifest.json`; run it before
`test` after a pin or shim change. CI runs the same sequence and then fails if
the committed manifest drifted.

The install proof lives at the repository root and needs `pnpm` and `dsh` on
`PATH`:

```sh
node scripts/verify-install.mjs
```

It packs both packages, installs the root tarball into a fresh DSH profile,
and asserts that the composed profile carries both loader rows
(`dsh-keys-manager` and `llm-omp-transports`). It does not exercise the
plugin-manager UI or any Cursor network behavior.

## Release

This package is released from the same release PR and carries the same version
as `dsh-keys-manager`; the root `CHANGELOG.md` and its generated sections cover
the root package only. A release-prep run writes one version to both
`package.json` files, and the Release workflow publishes both and pushes the
`dsh-llm-omp-transports@<version>` tag.
The root [release docs](../../docs/release.md) describe the full flow.

Package documentation is English-only; the root `README.md` /
`README.zh-CN.md` and the root `docs/*.zh-CN.md` files carry the bilingual
plugin surface.

## License

Released under the [MIT License](../../LICENSE).

# DSH Keys Manager

[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-keys-manager)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-keys-manager)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%5E22.19%20%7C%7C%20%3E%3D24-339933)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-keys-manager)
[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%5E0.2.1--rc.2-0969DA)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm)

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns one provider API key into a managed pool.
It extends the Models page rather than replacing it: providers, models, and the
model picker stay where they are; only the API-key source moves behind the
manager.

## Features

- Several keys per provider, each with an alias and health state.
- One key pinned to a session, with round-robin selection for new sessions.
- Bounded retry on the same key, then automatic failover to another key.
- Exponential cooldown recovery, capped at seven days.
- A search-driven Keys Manager page on the plugin's own detail page.
- A "managed by Keys Manager" badge inside the existing Models provider cards.
- Extra built-in providers installed as ordinary `llm-pi-ai` routes.
- OAuth account sign-in for seven pi-ai-backed providers, stored beside
  the API keys.
- A companion transport component for providers the vendored pi-ai cannot
  speak — Cursor (`cursor`) today — installed with the plugin.

### Extra providers

This catalog of 35 extra providers comes from
[oh-my-pi](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi)'s provider catalog (MIT).
