evidence.readmeExcerpt: # rdsh-web-cache DSH Web のシェル資産を **事前圧縮したまま配信**し、あわせて `Cache-Control: immutable` を付与するプロファイルバンドルです。 実装契約は [docs/webui-asset-cache.md](../../docs/webui-asset-cache.md)。 ## 2 つの動作 ### 1. 事前圧縮配信ルート（RDSH_WEB_ASSETS があるとき） rdsh が起動時にシェル資産を brotli q11 / gzip L6 で圧縮し、 `$DSH_HOME/webui/assets//` に `manifest.json` と `.br` / `.gz` を書きます（Rust 側の担当）。 環境変数 `RDSH_WEB_ASSETS` がそのディレクトリを指すとき、本プラグインは `/assets` の prefix ルートを登録し、以下を行います。 | 項目 | 挙動 | | ---- | ---- | | メソッド | `GET` / `HEAD` 以外は 405 | | 表現選択 | `br` → `gzip` → `identity` の優先順。`q=0` は除外。`*` は考慮しない | | ヘッダ | `content-type`（契約の表と同一）、`content-encoding`、`cache-control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable`、`etag`、`content-length`、必要なら `vary: accept-encoding` | | 再検証 | `If-None-Match` が manifest の etag と一致したら 304（ボディなし） | | HEAD | GET と同じヘッダを返し、ボディは送らない | | manifest に無いパス | `source` 配下に実ファイルがあれば identity で配信（安全網）、無ければ 404 | | 不正パス | 空・`..` を含む・絶対パス・壊れた percent-encoding は 404 | | 読み取り失敗 | 404（dist サーバと同じ） | 交渉の補足: 明示された coding を優先するため、`Accept-Encoding: gzip` だけの クライアントには gzip を返します。`br;q=0` のように br だけを拒否した場合は、 gzip が利用可能かつ未指定なら gzip に落ちます。ヘッダが無い・どの coding も 使えない場合は identity を返します（406 にはしません。最悪でも最適化が 効かないだけにするため）。 Node は圧縮しません。圧縮済みファイルを読むだけなので、リクエスト path の 圧縮 CPU はゼロです。 ### 2. キャッシュヘッダのタップ（常時） `RDSH_WEB_ASSETS` が無い場合の従来動作です。DSH のフロントエンドサーバは `/assets/*` に `content-type` しか返しません (`dsh-host-frontend-static/lib/index.js` の `res.writeHead(200, { "content-type": type })`)。本プラグインは `ServerResponse.writeHead` をラップし、**ハッシュ付き**のシェル資産にだけ `cache-control` を足します。応答本文は変更しません。ルート側が自分で `cache-control` を設定した場合はタップが触らないため、二重付与は起きません。 ## 何をしないか（安全側の設計） 1. **manifest が無い/壊れている/読めないときはルートを登録しません。** DSH は従来どおり dist サーバが配信します（fail-safe）。 2. **応答本文は作り変えません。** 圧縮済みバイト列をそのまま送るだけです。 3. **manifest に無い実ファイルは identity で配信します。** symlink や 作り直し直後の資産でシェルが欠けないための安全網です。 4. **dist サーバのフォールバック席は奪いません。** prefix ルートだけを 登録し、`index.html` や `/plugins/??` は素通しです。 ## 環境変数 | 変数 | 意味 | | ---- | ---- | | `RDSH_WEB_ASSETS` | 事前圧縮キャッシュの絶対パス。未設定ならルートを登録しない | | `RDSH_WEB_CACHE=0` | プラグイン全体を無効化（ヘッダタップもルートも登録しない） | `config.enabled: false` でも同じく無効化できます。 ## 検証 ```sh node --check index.js node --test test/cache-control.test.js test/headers.test.js test/assets-route.test.js ``` - `cache-control.test.js`: 純粋関数 `cacheControlFor` の単体テスト 5 件 - `headers.test.js`: 実 HTTP サーバでのヘッダタップ 3 件 - `assets-route.test.js`: 実 HTTP サーバ + tmpdir フィクスチャでの 交渉 / 304 / HEAD / 405 / 404 / トラバーサル / 安全網 / manifest 不正 / inject 登録経路 22 件 合計 30 件です。 # rdsh — a fast, safe Rust launcher for `dsh` [![ci](https://github.com/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![dashboard](https://github.com/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh/actions/workflows/dashboard.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh/actions/workflows/dashboard.yml) [![docs](https://github.com/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh/actions/workflows/docs.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh/actions/workflows/docs.yml) [![codecov](https://codecov.io/gh/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh/graph/badge.svg)](https://codecov.io/gh/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh) [![release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh.svg)](https://github.com/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh/releases) [![crates.io](https://img.shields.io/crates/v/rdsh.svg)](https://crates.io/crates/rdsh) [![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green.svg)](LICENSE) [![rust](https://img.shields.io/badge/rust-1.85%2B-orange.svg)](https://www.rust-lang.org/) [日本語](README.ja.md) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) An independent community project; not an official DeepSeek or DeepSeek Harness project. `rdsh` is a fast, safe launcher for [DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). It ports frequently used CLI operations (token calculation, code search, session management) to native Rust, while delegating conversation workflows and model execution transparently to upstream `dsh`. All existing arguments and options continue to work as-is. ## Why rdsh? - ⚡ **Sub-millisecond process launch**: `rdsh --version` starts in ~0.90 ms with ~2.9 MB peak RSS, versus ~88 ms and ~66 MB for Node.js-based `dsh --version`. This is process launch only: a booted agent profile still runs upstream Node.js, so conversation startup and session memory match upstream. See [Benchmarks](#benchmarks). - 🔄 **100% Drop-in Compatible**: Subcommands that are not rdsh-native are passed straight to upstream `dsh`. Existing scripts and workflows keep running unchanged. - 🛠 **Fast Native Utilities**: Estimate tokens, search code, list sessions, and run health diagnostics (`rdsh doctor`) instantly without starting Node.js. - 🛡 **Safe by Default**: Read-only commands never modify source files, credentials are never automatically synced or exported, and `rdsh_inspect` can be confined to explicitly shared files on Linux. - 🛠 **Fast Native Utilities**: Estimate tokens, search code, list sessions, and inspect local prerequisites (`rdsh doctor --json`) without starting Node.js. - 🛡 **Safe by Default**: Read-only commands never modify source files, credentials are never automatically synced or exported, and agent tools can be confined to explicitly shared files on Linux. The design rationale behind this hybrid split is documented in [docs/PHILOSOPHY.md](docs/PHILOSOPHY.md). ## Table of Contents - [Quick Start](#quick-start) - [Requirements](#requirements) - [Installation](#installation) - [Usage](#usage) - [Running with `dsh` Compatibility](#running-with-dsh-compatibility) - [Fast Native Commands](#fast-native-commands) - [Credential sharing with rdsh auth](#credential-sharing-with-rdsh-auth) - [Agent Tool Isolation](#agent-tool-isolation) - [Hook Guard](#hook-guard-rdsh-guard) - [Context Injection](#context-injection-rdsh-context) - [Dependency Graph and Change Impact](#dependency-graph-and-change-impact-rdsh-deps) - [Web UI & Dashboard](#web-ui--dashboard) - [Using with Smart-DSH](#using-with-smart-dsh) - [Benchmarks](#benchmarks) - [Safety Design](#safety-design) - [FAQ](#faq) - [Documentation](#documentation) - [Community](#community) - [Credits](#credits) - [License](#license) ## Quick Start Already using **Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code Copilot, OpenCode or Gemini CLI**? [Connect the project dashboard through MCP](docs/MCP-CLIENTS.md) to share tasks, questions and structured UI while keeping your current coding agent. This entry point requires Node.js 22+; DSH and Rust are optional. ### 1. Install (Prebuilt Binary) **Linux / macOS / WSL**: ```sh curl -fsSL https://github.com/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh/releases/latest/download/install.sh | bash -s -- --from-release ``` **Windows (PowerShell)**: ```powershell $f = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'rdsh-install.ps1' Invoke-WebRequest -Uri https://github.com/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh/releases/latest/download/install.ps1 -OutFile $f -UseBasicParsing & $f -FromRelease ``` Or install the crate from crates.io (needs Rust 1.85+): ```sh cargo install rdsh ``` `cargo install` builds from source and installs the same binary as the release archives. Debian/Ubuntu and Fedora/RHEL users can also install the release [`.deb`/`.rpm`](#native-packages-deb--rpm) with `apt`/`dnf`. ### 2. Verify & Setup ```sh rdsh --version && rdsh doctor # verify install and original dsh rdsh setup # interactive setup (or rdsh setup --web for browser UI) ``` *Note: If you have an existing login from Codex CLI (ChatGPT OAuth) or opencode, import it with `rdsh auth --import --provider openai-codex`.* ### 3. Start a Conversation ```sh rdsh tui # start with TUI profile # or rdsh --profile web # start with Web profile ``` ## Requirements | Item | Detail | | --- | --- | | OS | Linux, macOS, WSL, Windows (native) | | DSH runtime | Required for conversations and agent runs (native tools and diagnostics run standalone) | | Rust | 1.85+ (only needed when building from source; prebuilt binaries require no Rust) | | Optional | Node.js 22+ for the [Node.js dashboard](dashboard/README.md); SearXNG or an Ollama API key for `search-web` | ## Installation ### Native Packages (`.deb` / `.rpm`) Linux x86_64 users on Debian/Ubuntu (and WSL) or Fedora/RHEL can install the same release binary with the OS package manager. Download the `.deb` or `.rpm` from the [latest release](https://github.com/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh/releases/latest) and install that file directly; no extra repository is configured. ```sh sudo apt install ./rdsh__amd64.deb # Debian, Ubuntu, WSL sudo dnf install ./rdsh--1.x86_64.rpm # Fedora, RHEL, Rocky, AlmaLinux ``` `` is the release tag without its leading `v` (`0.6.0` for `v0.6.0`). The package installs `/usr/bin/rdsh` together with the licence and README, so `rdsh --version` works right after installation: no Rust toolchain, no `install.sh`. Like `rdsh-linux-x64.tar.gz`, both packages carry the glibc build, so the musl archive and `install.sh` stay the fallback for older distributions. ### Building from Source & Advanced Options **Linux / macOS / WSL**: ```sh git clone https://github.com/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh.git cd rustdsh ./install.sh # build + install to ~/.local/bin/rdsh ./install.sh --as-dsh # also replace `dsh` command (original backed up as dsh-orig) ./install.sh --restore # undo the replacement ./install.sh --prefix=DIR # custom install directory (default: ~/.local/bin) ``` **Windows (PowerShell)**: ```powershell git clone https://github.com/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh.git cd rustdsh .\install.ps1 # build + install to %LOCALAPPDATA%\rdsh\bin .\install.ps1 -AsDsh # also replace `dsh` command .\install.ps1 -Restore # undo the replacement .\install.ps1 -Wsl # also install inside WSL via install.sh ``` | OS | Script | Notes | | --- | --- | --- | | Linux / macOS | `./install.sh` | Needs `cargo` or `curl` (guided via rustup if missing). | | WSL | `./install.sh` inside distro | Auto-detects WSL. `install.ps1 -Wsl` installs in both environments. | | Windows (native) | `.\install.ps1` | Needs Rust and MSVC build tools (`winget install Rustlang.Rustup`). | ### Package Managers (Homebrew / Scoop / winget) Advanced users on macOS and Windows can let a package manager own the installed `rdsh` binary. The manifests in [packaging/](packaging/README.md) pin the exact release archives and their SHA-256 values; [docs/PACKAGE-MANAGERS.md](docs/PACKAGE-MANAGERS.md) lists the install commands and the update procedure. **macOS (Homebrew)** — installs the Apple Silicon or Intel archive: ```sh brew install --formula ./packaging/homebrew/rdsh.rb ``` **Windows (Scoop)**: ```powershell scoop install https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh/main/packaging/scoop/rdsh.json ``` **Windows (winget)** — winget 1.6 or newer reads the three manifests directly; submitting them to `microsoft/winget-pkgs` stays a manual step: ```powershell winget install --manifest .\packaging\winget ``` These channels track one release at a time, so a new tag is not served until `python3 scripts/update-packaging-manifests.py --version vX.Y.Z` refreshes them. ## Usage ### Running with `dsh` Compatibility Run any standard `dsh` command unchanged: ```sh rdsh tui # equivalent to: dsh --profile tui rdsh --profile web --patch x.yml # launch with configuration overlay rdsh --dry-run tui -- --resume id # print what would be executed ``` When installed with `./install.sh --as-dsh`, typing `dsh` automatically uses the fast `rdsh` launcher. ### Fast Native Commands Native tools execute in Rust without starting Node.js: ```sh rdsh tokens ./README.md # estimate token count (~4 chars = 1 tok, CJK = 1 tok each) echo "..." | rdsh prune --max-tokens 4000 # prune context within a token budget rdsh search TODO --dir . --max 100 # fast parallel text search rdsh sessions --limit 20 --tokens # list sessions and unpacked token estimates rdsh compact ./s.jsonl # compact session JSONL (source remains untouched) rdsh doctor # check health of dsh, environment, and paths rdsh doctor --json # read-only metadata for scripts; no DSH/Node launch rdsh profiles / rdsh skills # list available profiles and skills rdsh desktop status # detect the DeepSeek Harness Desktop app and profile rdsh plugins status # essential plugins a profile is still missing rdsh plugins install --profile web # attach them after an upgrade rdsh bench --n 5 # benchmark startup speed between rdsh and dsh ``` On Windows, compressed session histories are not opened until rdsh can reject parent junctions safely; `sessions --tokens` may omit those histories and its totals are inexact. ### Plugin provisioning (`rdsh plugins`) The essential plugin tier (the upstream tools absent from `dsh-base` plus the bundled rdsh plugins) only lived in `plugins/install.sh`, and nothing runs that script by itself: upgrading the binary leaves the profile manifest untouched, so an install can miss every essential package without any signal. The same catalog is compiled into the binary, so a release install can see and close the gap without the checkout: ```sh rdsh plugins status # read-only state per package, plus the fix rdsh plugins status --profile web --json # schema 1 for scripts and dashboards rdsh plugins install # attach what the profile is missing rdsh plugins install --profile web # web/desktop defaults also add the starter set rdsh plugins install --recommended=none # the essential tier only rdsh plugins install --no-bundled # no checkout: the upstream tools only rdsh plugins install --plugins-dir # or export RDSH_PLUGINS_DIR ``` Packages go through `dsh plugin --profile add ` (`RDSH_DSH_BIN` overrides the CLI), exactly as the checkout installer does. Bundled plugins are resolved from the checkout, and an absent checkout is reported instead of being skipped quietly. `rdsh doctor` prints the same gap for every initialized profile, and `--profile desktop` forwards to `rdsh desktop install`. See [plugins/recommended.md](plugins/recommended.md) for the tiers and the ids. ### Credential sharing with rdsh auth External credentials are inventoried without showing their values. Nothing is copied until you select a source and credential. OAuth copies use DSH's existing version-1 store at $DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml; API keys use its named refs. The selection policy contains only identifiers at $DSH_HOME/rdsh-auth-sharing.json. ```sh rdsh auth # sources, destinations, selection and undo steps rdsh auth --json # secret-free machine-readable inventory rdsh --dry-run auth --select codex:openai-codex --import # preview; writes no files rdsh auth --select codex:openai-codex --import # share only Codex OAuth rdsh auth --select opencode:openai-codex --import # OpenCode openai maps to openai-codex rdsh auth --select codex:OPENAI_API_KEY --import # separate opt-in for Codex's API key rdsh auth --select env:DEEPSEEK_API_KEY --import # explicitly persist this environment key rdsh auth --unselect codex:openai-codex # stop future copies; retain the existing copy rdsh setup # sync selected credentials, then guide setup rdsh setup --web # inventory, selection commands and explicit key save ``` For a one-time import, use `rdsh auth --import --provider openai-codex --source codex` or `rdsh auth --import --ref OPENAI_API_KEY --source codex`. These filters do not save or extend future-copy consent; `--select`/`--unselect` are separate persistent policy changes. Repeat --select/--unselect for individual credentials. Selecting enables future imports from that CLI/provider, including boot, dump-config, plugin, raw dsh delegation and setup. --import immediately applies the selection. Even a newer grant in another, unselected CLI cannot be chosen. Newer DSH grants and existing API-key refs/records remain in place. Other entries, comments and line endings are preserved. Unix credential and policy files use mode 0600. The inventory checks Codex's ~/.codex/auth.json and OpenCode's $XDG_DATA_HOME/opencode/auth.json (or its platform default data directory), plus the legacy ~/.config/opencode/auth.json fallback. Selectors for OpenCode use DSH provider IDs; opencode:openai-codex is the selector for its openai login. Environment-key persistence supports DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. These are format/presence checks, not live authentication tests. An environment variable already supplied to rdsh is inherited by DSH and its child processes without rdsh writing a file. The JSON inventory marks this route persistent=false, lists its destination and explains how to stop/revoke it. Using the reference does not opt in to storing it. setup --yes no longer saves every environment key; choose each one with auth --select env:NAME --import. Interactive setup and the web form still allow an explicit, individual key save. **Scope and undo:** saved entries are available to every DSH profile using the same DSH_HOME. Unselect stops future rdsh imports; it does not delete a saved copy or invalidate a running process. Stop DSH and remove the named record/ref from the credential store to stop using a saved copy. To invalidate the credential itself, revoke the OAuth grant or rotate the API key at its provider. That may also disconnect the source CLI. This controls rdsh copying, not DSH's own refreshes, inherited environment access or an OS sandbox. **Migration:** existing DSH credentials are retained. A missing policy selects nothing, including for legacy auth --import. RDSH_AUTH_AUTOSYNC=1 does not restore the old import-all behavior. Inventory and preview first, then choose the sources you need. RDSH_AUTH_AUTOSYNC=0 disables automatic imports while keeping the selection; an explicit auth --import still works. Invalid/unreadable policies fail closed instead of falling back to legacy sync. Consent changes and rdsh credential writes share a lock, so a completed unselect cannot be bypassed by a queued rdsh import using an earlier policy. After a crashed writer, check that no rdsh auth/setup writer is active before removing $DSH_HOME/.rdsh-auth-sharing.lock; the launcher skips copying while it is locked. setup --web issues a new local access key at startup in its #key=... URL. The tab retains that key; status reads, key saves and closing require it. Keep the startup URL private. The page shows copy destinations and separate unselect, saved-copy removal and provider revocation steps before a key save. ### Optional extras (off by default) Server-type features and the privacy-sensitive switches (`discord`, `telemetry`) stay off until enabled, so a plain install remains a fast, telemetry-free dsh: ```sh rdsh settings set extras.enable serve,search-web rdsh settings get extras.enable ``` | Extra | Command | Notes | | --- | --- | --- | | `serve` | `rdsh serve` (default :38080) | Local status page, localhost only, per-launch key. | | `search-web` | `rdsh search-web "query" --limit 5` | SearXNG by default; `--provider ollama` uses `OLLAMA_API_KEY`; `--auto-start` starts the bundled local SearXNG compose service. See [Web search](docs/WEB-SEARCH.md). | To connect an OpenAI-compatible endpoint that dsh does not ship (HAI, Command Code, Sarashina, a home llama.cpp / vLLM / LM Studio / Ollama server), add it as a profile route: ```sh rdsh provider add hai --model deepseek-v4-flash # key from HAI_API_KEY or --key-stdin rdsh provider add commandcode --model deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash # key from COMMANDCODE_API_KEY rdsh provider add sarashina # key from SARASHINA_API_KEY; mini and nano built in rdsh provider add local-openai --base-url http://host:8080/v1 --discover --no-key rdsh provider list # presets, per-profile route and key status ``` Details: [docs/PROVIDERS.md](docs/PROVIDERS.md). ### Model Catalog (`rdsh models`) DeepSeek Harness answers "which models can this provider serve?" from the catalog bundled in its `@earendil-works/pi-ai` dependency, which is generated when that package is published. Anything a provider changes afterwards is absent from the picker until that dependency is upgraded — and a profile that lists `models:` explicitly replaces the bundled catalog for the route anyway. `rdsh models` reads the provider's own catalog (the local Codex CLI, or Kimi Code's `/v1/models` endpoint with the profile's API key) and folds it into the profile: ```sh rdsh models # read-only: missing ids and stale names rdsh models --provider kimi-coding # one provider only rdsh models sync # add missing entries, refresh stale names rdsh models sync --profile web --dry-run # preview one profile ``` Nothing is deleted, an existing entry keeps every other byte (a name the provider's current one already contains is left as written), and a profile the command does not recognize is refused instead of rewritten. The harness picks the changes up on the next config reload or restart. ### Agent Tool Isolation Delegated agent tools keep normal file access by default: the model reads and writes the project like any other tool. `--share-file` isolates **`rdsh_inspect` only**. On Linux (with bubblewrap and prlimit) that tool sees just the files you explicitly share: ```sh rdsh --share-file README.md --share-file src/main.rs --profile tui ``` From `rdsh_inspect`, only the shared files are mounted read-only, host files stay out of reach and the sandbox has no network. Turn the same boundary on for every run with `rdsh features on agent_tool_sandbox` (off again with `rdsh features off agent_tool_sandbox`, or force it with `RDSH_SECURITY=1`). Other DSH tools (`bash`, `read`, `write`, `run_code`, ...) are **not** isolated and follow upstream DSH permissions and approvals. Startup prints `[rdsh security] rdsh_inspect is isolated; other DSH tools use upstream permissions`. ### Hook Guard (`rdsh guard`) Integrates with DSH `hooks.json` to inspect and block dangerous commands before execution: ```sh echo "$input" | rdsh guard --deny "rm -rf /*" --deny "*token*" ``` For an opt-in structured check of supported file tools, pass a policy file. This example permits `Read` only under one existing project directory: ```json { "schema": 1, "rules": [ { "id": "project-read", "tool": "Read", "access": "read", "roots": ["/absolute/project/path"] } ] } ``` ```sh echo "$hook_json" | rdsh guard --policy-file ./hook-policy.json --json ``` The structured classifier supports the `Read`, `Write`, and `Edit` file-path schemas. It canonicalizes the working directory and target, checks the selected tool and read/write scope against existing policy roots, and reports `allow`, `deny`, or `unknown` with a non-sensitive reason. In JSON mode an `allow` is classification only and omits `decision`; the host still owns permission and approval. Unknown tools, shell commands, malformed input, and unsupported tool arguments fail closed. Shell parsing and network destinations are not implemented. Path checks are advisory and can race with later filesystem changes; this hook is not an OS sandbox. Use the actual execution sandbox for enforcement. ```json { "hooks": { "PreToolUse": [ { "matcher": "Bash", "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "rdsh guard --deny \"rm -rf /*\"" }] } ] } } ``` ### Context Injection (`rdsh context`) `rdsh context inject` assembles this turn's context — goal, constraints, decisions, working set, git state, retrieved code, and curated memory — and emits it in the DSH `UserPromptSubmit` hook contract, so the model sees it without any copy-paste: ```sh rdsh features on context_engine # the engine is opt-in rdsh context hook install # merges $DSH_HOME/hooks.json (idempotent) rdsh context hook status --json ``` The hook is fail-open: it never blocks a prompt and always exits 0. Only an unreadable settings document or an unparseable payload inject nothing at all; a corrupt index or a missed deadline drops just what depends on them — the graph or the code search — and still injects goal, constraints, and memory. Injection has its own budget (`context.inject_budget`, default 1200 tokens) and deadline (`context.inject_deadline_ms`, default 1200 ms); once the deadline passes the code search is skipped and only memory, goal, and constraints go out. Memory holds curated items, not a transcript dump: ```sh rdsh context remember "Keep the API compatible" --kind constraint rdsh context distill --session ~/.dsh/sessions///session.v4.jsonl.zstd --apply rdsh context memory --json # active and superseded entries rdsh context forget mem_ab12cd34ef56 ``` `distill` reads user turns only (zstd session logs included) and extracts decisions, constraints, and retractions with deterministic markers, superseding an older overlapping entry instead of guessing. `rdsh context build --require-stable` exits 3 unless the snapshot is provably stable: a file or git state that changed during assembly counts, and so does a git state it cannot read, so a stale or unknown snapshot is never reported as fresh. ### Dependency Graph and Change Impact (`rdsh deps`) ```sh rdsh deps build # incremental index under $DSH_HOME/rdsh-index rdsh deps query engine_score # where a symbol is defined and referenced rdsh deps impact src/context.rs # direct/transitive dependents + affected tests ``` The extractor covers Rust, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, and Go and records imports, definitions, and static call sites per file. Unchanged files (same size and mtime) are reused, so repeated runs stay fast. It is a static approximation: dynamic dispatch, indirect calls, macros, and generated code remain explicitly `unknown` and are reported as unresolved counts rather than guessed, and a missing index means "no information", never "no dependencies". When the index exists, `rdsh context build` and `rdsh context inject` also pull in the graph neighbours of the files their search matched, so a retrieved excerpt arrives with the files it actually depends on. Native execution overhead is ~1 ms per invocation. ## Low-end hosts Default profile: `RDSH_DEFAULT_PROFILE`, then `general.default_profile` in rdsh settings, then local `tui`, else a guided error. Set the saved default with `rdsh settings set general.default_profile web`; an explicit `--profile ` keeps its precedence. rdsh aims to remain useful on modest machines: older x86-64 CPUs, older Linux distributions, and hosts without Node.js installed. - **Faster Node startup.** When rdsh launches dsh, it sets `NODE_COMPILE_CACHE` to `~/.cache/rdsh-node-compile-cache`, letting Node reuse compiled code across launches (Node 22.1 or newer; older versions ignore it). An existing `NODE_COMPILE_CACHE` value is preserved. Set `RDSH_NODE_COMPILE_CACHE=0`, or use `--passthrough` / `RDSH_PASSTHROUGH=1`, to opt out. Set `RDSH_NODE_COMPILE_CACHE=` to keep the cache at a fixed location instead of the default, for example on hosts where `$HOME` is volatile. - **Broad CPU support.** Prebuilt x86-64 binaries do not require AVX or BMI; the static musl build also runs on systems with older glibc. - **Session token estimates.** `sessions --tokens` reads a decompressed size from the zstd frame header when available. Most streaming frames need the `zstd -dc` fallback. Results are cached under `~/.cache/rdsh/sessions-tokens.json` (`$XDG_CACHE_HOME` takes precedence); set `RDSH_TOKENS_CACHE=0` to disable the cache. A `?` marks an estimate that could not be read, for example when the zstd CLI is unavailable. - **Bounded parallel work.** Search and session scans use at most eight worker threads. The zstd CLI fallback uses 8 to 32 parallel processes. - **Native commands without Node.** Commands such as `tokens`, `search`, and `sessions` keep working without Node. To delegate conversations, install `@deepseek-ai/dsh` or set `DSH_ORIG_BIN` (or `RDSH_ORIG_BIN`). - **Low-priority updates.** `sync-dsh.sh` updates dsh and rdsh, verifies archive bytes against that registry, and rolls back a failed update candidate. By default it uses the stable release selected by the reviewed repository digest registry; set `RDSH_SYNC_FROM_SOURCE=1` to build from `main` under `nice -n 19` and `ionice -c3` when available. The systemd unit runs at low priority; adjust its `ExecStart` to your checkout. ## Web UI & Dashboard ### Lightweight Local Web UI (`rdsh serve`) A lightweight status and token estimation page running on localhost (default `:38080`, does not conflict with DSH `:3080`): ```sh rdsh settings set extras.enable serve # enable the server feature rdsh serve # launch (bound to localhost, protected with a one-time token) ``` ### Product language rdsh-owned CLI diagnostics and the native local page support English, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese. Choose one run with `--language`, or persist it in `rdsh.json`; the default `auto` reads the first nonblank locale environment variable, falling back to English when it is absent or unsupported. ```sh rdsh --language ja settings show rdsh settings set general.language zh-CN ``` Precedence is `--language`, `RDSH_LANG`, `general.language`, then `LC_ALL`, `LC_MESSAGES`, and `LANG`. An explicitly invalid `general.language` stops the command without rewriting the settings file. Delegated `dsh` arguments, mod

evidence.readmeExcerpt: # rdsh — a fast, safe Rust launcher for `dsh` [![ci](https://github.com/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![dashboard](https://github.com/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh/actions/workflows/dashboard.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh/actions/workflows/dashboard.yml) [![docs](https://github.com/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh/actions/workflows/docs.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh/actions/workflows/docs.yml) [![codecov](https://codecov.io/gh/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh/graph/badge.svg)](https://codecov.io/gh/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh) [![release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh.svg)](https://github.com/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh/releases) [![crates.io](https://img.shields.io/crates/v/rdsh.svg)](https://crates.io/crates/rdsh) [![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green.svg)](LICENSE) [![rust](https://img.shields.io/badge/rust-1.85%2B-orange.svg)](https://www.rust-lang.org/) [日本語](README.ja.md) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) An independent community project; not an official DeepSeek or DeepSeek Harness project. `rdsh` is a fast, safe launcher for [DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). It ports frequently used CLI operations (token calculation, code search, session management) to native Rust, while delegating conversation workflows and model execution transparently to upstream `dsh`. All existing arguments and options continue to work as-is. ## Why rdsh? - ⚡ **Sub-millisecond process launch**: `rdsh --version` starts in ~0.90 ms with ~2.9 MB peak RSS, versus ~88 ms and ~66 MB for Node.js-based `dsh --version`. This is process launch only: a booted agent profile still runs upstream Node.js, so conversation startup and session memory match upstream. See [Benchmarks](#benchmarks). - 🔄 **100% Drop-in Compatible**: Subcommands that are not rdsh-native are passed straight to upstream `dsh`. Existing scripts and workflows keep running unchanged. - 🛠 **Fast Native Utilities**: Estimate tokens, search code, list sessions, and run health diagnostics (`rdsh doctor`) instantly without starting Node.js. - 🛡 **Safe by Default**: Read-only commands never modify source files, credentials are never automatically synced or exported, and `rdsh_inspect` can be confined to explicitly shared files on Linux. - 🛠 **Fast Native Utilities**: Estimate tokens, search code, list sessions, and inspect local prerequisites (`rdsh doctor --json`) without starting Node.js. - 🛡 **Safe by Default**: Read-only commands never modify source files, credentials are never automatically synced or exported, and agent tools can be confined to explicitly shared files on Linux. The design rationale behind this hybrid split is documented in [docs/PHILOSOPHY.md](docs/PHILOSOPHY.md). ## Table of Contents - [Quick Start](#quick-start) - [Requirements](#requirements) - [Installation](#installation) - [Usage](#usage) - [Running with `dsh` Compatibility](#running-with-dsh-compatibility) - [Fast Native Commands](#fast-native-commands) - [Credential sharing with rdsh auth](#credential-sharing-with-rdsh-auth) - [Agent Tool Isolation](#agent-tool-isolation) - [Hook Guard](#hook-guard-rdsh-guard) - [Context Injection](#context-injection-rdsh-context) - [Dependency Graph and Change Impact](#dependency-graph-and-change-impact-rdsh-deps) - [Web UI & Dashboard](#web-ui--dashboard) - [Using with Smart-DSH](#using-with-smart-dsh) - [Benchmarks](#benchmarks) - [Safety Design](#safety-design) - [FAQ](#faq) - [Documentation](#documentation) - [Community](#community) - [Credits](#credits) - [License](#license) ## Quick Start Already using **Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code Copilot, OpenCode or Gemini CLI**? [Connect the project dashboard through MCP](docs/MCP-CLIENTS.md) to share tasks, questions and structured UI while keeping your current coding agent. This entry point requires Node.js 22+; DSH and Rust are optional. ### 1. Install (Prebuilt Binary) **Linux / macOS / WSL**: ```sh curl -fsSL https://github.com/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh/releases/latest/download/install.sh | bash -s -- --from-release ``` **Windows (PowerShell)**: ```powershell $f = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'rdsh-install.ps1' Invoke-WebRequest -Uri https://github.com/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh/releases/latest/download/install.ps1 -OutFile $f -UseBasicParsing & $f -FromRelease ``` Or install the crate from crates.io (needs Rust 1.85+): ```sh cargo install rdsh ``` `cargo install` builds from source and installs the same binary as the release archives. Debian/Ubuntu and Fedora/RHEL users can also install the release [`.deb`/`.rpm`](#native-packages-deb--rpm) with `apt`/`dnf`. ### 2. Verify & Setup ```sh rdsh --version && rdsh doctor # verify install and original dsh rdsh setup # interactive setup (or rdsh setup --web for browser UI) ``` *Note: If you have an existing login from Codex CLI (ChatGPT OAuth) or opencode, import it with `rdsh auth --import --provider openai-codex`.* ### 3. Start a Conversation ```sh rdsh tui # start with TUI profile # or rdsh --profile web # start with Web profile ``` ## Requirements | Item | Detail | | --- | --- | | OS | Linux, macOS, WSL, Windows (native) | | DSH runtime | Required for conversations and agent runs (native tools and diagnostics run standalone) | | Rust | 1.85+ (only needed when building from source; prebuilt binaries require no Rust) | | Optional | Node.js 22+ for the [Node.js dashboard](dashboard/README.md); SearXNG or an Ollama API key for `search-web` | ## Installation ### Native Packages (`.deb` / `.rpm`) Linux x86_64 users on Debian/Ubuntu (and WSL) or Fedora/RHEL can install the same release binary with the OS package manager. Download the `.deb` or `.rpm` from the [latest release](https://github.com/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh/releases/latest) and install that file directly; no extra repository is configured. ```sh sudo apt install ./rdsh__amd64.deb # Debian, Ubuntu, WSL sudo dnf install ./rdsh--1.x86_64.rpm # Fedora, RHEL, Rocky, AlmaLinux ``` `` is the release tag without its leading `v` (`0.6.0` for `v0.6.0`). The package installs `/usr/bin/rdsh` together with the licence and README, so `rdsh --version` works right after installation: no Rust toolchain, no `install.sh`. Like `rdsh-linux-x64.tar.gz`, both packages carry the glibc build, so the musl archive and `install.sh` stay the fallback for older distributions. ### Building from Source & Advanced Options **Linux / macOS / WSL**: ```sh git clone https://github.com/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh.git cd rustdsh ./install.sh # build + install to ~/.local/bin/rdsh ./install.sh --as-dsh # also replace `dsh` command (original backed up as dsh-orig) ./install.sh --restore # undo the replacement ./install.sh --prefix=DIR # custom install directory (default: ~/.local/bin) ``` **Windows (PowerShell)**: ```powershell git clone https://github.com/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh.git cd rustdsh .\install.ps1 # build + install to %LOCALAPPDATA%\rdsh\bin .\install.ps1 -AsDsh # also replace `dsh` command .\install.ps1 -Restore # undo the replacement .\install.ps1 -Wsl # also install inside WSL via install.sh ``` | OS | Script | Notes | | --- | --- | --- | | Linux / macOS | `./install.sh` | Needs `cargo` or `curl` (guided via rustup if missing). | | WSL | `./install.sh` inside distro | Auto-detects WSL. `install.ps1 -Wsl` installs in both environments. | | Windows (native) | `.\install.ps1` | Needs Rust and MSVC build tools (`winget install Rustlang.Rustup`). | ### Package Managers (Homebrew / Scoop / winget) Advanced users on macOS and Windows can let a package manager own the installed `rdsh` binary. The manifests in [packaging/](packaging/README.md) pin the exact release archives and their SHA-256 values; [docs/PACKAGE-MANAGERS.md](docs/PACKAGE-MANAGERS.md) lists the install commands and the update procedure. **macOS (Homebrew)** — installs the Apple Silicon or Intel archive: ```sh brew install --formula ./packaging/homebrew/rdsh.rb ``` **Windows (Scoop)**: ```powershell scoop install https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh/main/packaging/scoop/rdsh.json ``` **Windows (winget)** — winget 1.6 or newer reads the three manifests directly; submitting them to `microsoft/winget-pkgs` stays a manual step: ```powershell winget install --manifest .\packaging\winget ``` These channels track one release at a time, so a new tag is not served until `python3 scripts/update-packaging-manifests.py --version vX.Y.Z` refreshes them. ## Usage ### Running with `dsh` Compatibility Run any standard `dsh` command unchanged: ```sh rdsh tui # equivalent to: dsh --profile tui rdsh --profile web --patch x.yml # launch with configuration overlay rdsh --dry-run tui -- --resume id # print what would be executed ``` When installed with `./install.sh --as-dsh`, typing `dsh` automatically uses the fast `rdsh` launcher. ### Fast Native Commands Native tools execute in Rust without starting Node.js: ```sh rdsh tokens ./README.md # estimate token count (~4 chars = 1 tok, CJK = 1 tok each) echo "..." | rdsh prune --max-tokens 4000 # prune context within a token budget rdsh search TODO --dir . --max 100 # fast parallel text search rdsh sessions --limit 20 --tokens # list sessions and unpacked token estimates rdsh compact ./s.jsonl # compact session JSONL (source remains untouched) rdsh doctor # check health of dsh, environment, and paths rdsh doctor --json # read-only metadata for scripts; no DSH/Node launch rdsh profiles / rdsh skills # list available profiles and skills rdsh desktop status # detect the DeepSeek Harness Desktop app and profile rdsh plugins status # essential plugins a profile is still missing rdsh plugins install --profile web # attach them after an upgrade rdsh bench --n 5 # benchmark startup speed between rdsh and dsh ``` On Windows, compressed session histories are not opened until rdsh can reject parent junctions safely; `sessions --tokens` may omit those histories and its totals are inexact. ### Plugin provisioning (`rdsh plugins`) The essential plugin tier (the upstream tools absent from `dsh-base` plus the bundled rdsh plugins) only lived in `plugins/install.sh`, and nothing runs that script by itself: upgrading the binary leaves the profile manifest untouched, so an install can miss every essential package without any signal. The same catalog is compiled into the binary, so a release install can see and close the gap without the checkout: ```sh rdsh plugins status # read-only state per package, plus the fix rdsh plugins status --profile web --json # schema 1 for scripts and dashboards rdsh plugins install # attach what the profile is missing rdsh plugins install --profile web # web/desktop defaults also add the starter set rdsh plugins install --recommended=none # the essential tier only rdsh plugins install --no-bundled # no checkout: the upstream tools only rdsh plugins install --plugins-dir # or export RDSH_PLUGINS_DIR ``` Packages go through `dsh plugin --profile add ` (`RDSH_DSH_BIN` overrides the CLI), exactly as the checkout installer does. Bundled plugins are resolved from the checkout, and an absent checkout is reported instead of being skipped quietly. `rdsh doctor` prints the same gap for every initialized profile, and `--profile desktop` forwards to `rdsh desktop install`. See [plugins/recommended.md](plugins/recommended.md) for the tiers and the ids. ### Credential sharing with rdsh auth External credentials are inventoried without showing their values. Nothing is copied until you select a source and credential. OAuth copies use DSH's existing version-1 store at $DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml; API keys use its named refs. The selection policy contains only identifiers at $DSH_HOME/rdsh-auth-sharing.json. ```sh rdsh auth # sources, destinations, selection and undo steps rdsh auth --json # secret-free machine-readable inventory rdsh --dry-run auth --select codex:openai-codex --import # preview; writes no files rdsh auth --select codex:openai-codex --import # share only Codex OAuth rdsh auth --select opencode:openai-codex --import # OpenCode openai maps to openai-codex rdsh auth --select codex:OPENAI_API_KEY --import # separate opt-in for Codex's API key rdsh auth --select env:DEEPSEEK_API_KEY --import # explicitly persist this environment key rdsh auth --unselect codex:openai-codex # stop future copies; retain the existing copy rdsh setup # sync selected credentials, then guide setup rdsh setup --web # inventory, selection commands and explicit key save ``` For a one-time import, use `rdsh auth --import --provider openai-codex --source codex` or `rdsh auth --import --ref OPENAI_API_KEY --source codex`. These filters do not save or extend future-copy consent; `--select`/`--unselect` are separate persistent policy changes. Repeat --select/--unselect for individual credentials. Selecting enables future imports from that CLI/provider, including boot, dump-config, plugin, raw dsh delegation and setup. --import immediately applies the selection. Even a newer grant in another, unselected CLI cannot be chosen. Newer DSH grants and existing API-key refs/records remain in place. Other entries, comments and line endings are preserved. Unix credential and policy files use mode 0600. The inventory checks Codex's ~/.codex/auth.json and OpenCode's $XDG_DATA_HOME/opencode/auth.json (or its platform default data directory), plus the legacy ~/.config/opencode/auth.json fallback. Selectors for OpenCode use DSH provider IDs; opencode:openai-codex is the selector for its openai login. Environment-key persistence supports DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. These are format/presence checks, not live authentication tests. An environment variable already supplied to rdsh is inherited by DSH and its child processes without rdsh writing a file. The JSON inventory marks this route persistent=false, lists its destination and explains how to stop/revoke it. Using the reference does not opt in to storing it. setup --yes no longer saves every environment key; choose each one with auth --select env:NAME --import. Interactive setup and the web form still allow an explicit, individual key save. **Scope and undo:** saved entries are available to every DSH profile using the same DSH_HOME. Unselect stops future rdsh imports; it does not delete a saved copy or invalidate a running process. Stop DSH and remove the named record/ref from the credential store to stop using a saved copy. To invalidate the credential itself, revoke the OAuth grant or rotate the API key at its provider. That may also disconnect the source CLI. This controls rdsh copying, not DSH's own refreshes, inherited environment access or an OS sandbox. **Migration:** existing DSH credentials are retained. A missing policy selects nothing, including for legacy auth --import. RDSH_AUTH_AUTOSYNC=1 does not restore the old import-all behavior. Inventory and preview first, then choose the sources you need. RDSH_AUTH_AUTOSYNC=0 disables automatic imports while keeping the selection; an explicit auth --import still works. Invalid/unreadable policies fail closed instead of falling back to legacy sync. Consent changes and rdsh credential writes share a lock, so a completed unselect cannot be bypassed by a queued rdsh import using an earlier policy. After a crashed writer, check that no rdsh auth/setup writer is active before removing $DSH_HOME/.rdsh-auth-sharing.lock; the launcher skips copying while it is locked. setup --web issues a new local access key at startup in its #key=... URL. The tab retains that key; status reads, key saves and closing require it. Keep the startup URL private. The page shows copy destinations and separate unselect, saved-copy removal and provider revocation steps before a key save. ### Optional extras (off by default) Server-type features and the privacy-sensitive switches (`discord`, `telemetry`) stay off until enabled, so a plain install remains a fast, telemetry-free dsh: ```sh rdsh settings set extras.enable serve,search-web rdsh settings get extras.enable ``` | Extra | Command | Notes | | --- | --- | --- | | `serve` | `rdsh serve` (default :38080) | Local status page, localhost only, per-launch key. | | `search-web` | `rdsh search-web "query" --limit 5` | SearXNG by default; `--provider ollama` uses `OLLAMA_API_KEY`; `--auto-start` starts the bundled local SearXNG compose service. See [Web search](docs/WEB-SEARCH.md). | To connect an OpenAI-compatible endpoint that dsh does not ship (HAI, Command Code, Sarashina, a home llama.cpp / vLLM / LM Studio / Ollama server), add it as a profile route: ```sh rdsh provider add hai --model deepseek-v4-flash # key from HAI_API_KEY or --key-stdin rdsh provider add commandcode --model deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash # key from COMMANDCODE_API_KEY rdsh provider add sarashina # key from SARASHINA_API_KEY; mini and nano built in rdsh provider add local-openai --base-url http://host:8080/v1 --discover --no-key rdsh provider list # presets, per-profile route and key status ``` Details: [docs/PROVIDERS.md](docs/PROVIDERS.md). ### Model Catalog (`rdsh models`) DeepSeek Harness answers "which models can this provider serve?" from the catalog bundled in its `@earendil-works/pi-ai` dependency, which is generated when that package is published. Anything a provider changes afterwards is absent from the picker until that dependency is upgraded — and a profile that lists `models:` explicitly replaces the bundled catalog for the route anyway. `rdsh models` reads the provider's own catalog (the local Codex CLI, or Kimi Code's `/v1/models` endpoint with the profile's API key) and folds it into the profile: ```sh rdsh models # read-only: missing ids and stale names rdsh models --provider kimi-coding # one provider only rdsh models sync # add missing entries, refresh stale names rdsh models sync --profile web --dry-run # preview one profile ``` Nothing is deleted, an existing entry keeps every other byte (a name the provider's current one already contains is left as written), and a profile the command does not recognize is refused instead of rewritten. The harness picks the changes up on the next config reload or restart. ### Agent Tool Isolation Delegated agent tools keep normal file access by default: the model reads and writes the project like any other tool. `--share-file` isolates **`rdsh_inspect` only**. On Linux (with bubblewrap and prlimit) that tool sees just the files you explicitly share: ```sh rdsh --share-file README.md --share-file src/main.rs --profile tui ``` From `rdsh_inspect`, only the shared files are mounted read-only, host files stay out of reach and the sandbox has no network. Turn the same boundary on for every run with `rdsh features on agent_tool_sandbox` (off again with `rdsh features off agent_tool_sandbox`, or force it with `RDSH_SECURITY=1`). Other DSH tools (`bash`, `read`, `write`, `run_code`, ...) are **not** isolated and follow upstream DSH permissions and approvals. Startup prints `[rdsh security] rdsh_inspect is isolated; other DSH tools use upstream permissions`. ### Hook Guard (`rdsh guard`) Integrates with DSH `hooks.json` to inspect and block dangerous commands before execution: ```sh echo "$input" | rdsh guard --deny "rm -rf /*" --deny "*token*" ``` For an opt-in structured check of supported file tools, pass a policy file. This example permits `Read` only under one existing project directory: ```json { "schema": 1, "rules": [ { "id": "project-read", "tool": "Read", "access": "read", "roots": ["/absolute/project/path"] } ] } ``` ```sh echo "$hook_json" | rdsh guard --policy-file ./hook-policy.json --json ``` The structured classifier supports the `Read`, `Write`, and `Edit` file-path schemas. It canonicalizes the working directory and target, checks the selected tool and read/write scope against existing policy roots, and reports `allow`, `deny`, or `unknown` with a non-sensitive reason. In JSON mode an `allow` is classification only and omits `decision`; the host still owns permission and approval. Unknown tools, shell commands, malformed input, and unsupported tool arguments fail closed. Shell parsing and network destinations are not implemented. Path checks are advisory and can race with later filesystem changes; this hook is not an OS sandbox. Use the actual execution sandbox for enforcement. ```json { "hooks": { "PreToolUse": [ { "matcher": "Bash", "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "rdsh guard --deny \"rm -rf /*\"" }] } ] } } ``` ### Context Injection (`rdsh context`) `rdsh context inject` assembles this turn's context — goal, constraints, decisions, working set, git state, retrieved code, and curated memory — and emits it in the DSH `UserPromptSubmit` hook contract, so the model sees it without any copy-paste: ```sh rdsh features on context_engine # the engine is opt-in rdsh context hook install # merges $DSH_HOME/hooks.json (idempotent) rdsh context hook status --json ``` The hook is fail-open: it never blocks a prompt and always exits 0. Only an unreadable settings document or an unparseable payload inject nothing at all; a corrupt index or a missed deadline drops just what depends on them — the graph or the code search — and still injects goal, constraints, and memory. Injection has its own budget (`context.inject_budget`, default 1200 tokens) and deadline (`context.inject_deadline_ms`, default 1200 ms); once the deadline passes the code search is skipped and only memory, goal, and constraints go out. Memory holds curated items, not a transcript dump: ```sh rdsh context remember "Keep the API compatible" --kind constraint rdsh context distill --session ~/.dsh/sessions///session.v4.jsonl.zstd --apply rdsh context memory --json # active and superseded entries rdsh context forget mem_ab12cd34ef56 ``` `distill` reads user turns only (zstd session logs included) and extracts decisions, constraints, and retractions with deterministic markers, superseding an older overlapping entry instead of guessing. `rdsh context build --require-stable` exits 3 unless the snapshot is provably stable: a file or git state that changed during assembly counts, and so does a git state it cannot read, so a stale or unknown snapshot is never reported as fresh. ### Dependency Graph and Change Impact (`rdsh deps`) ```sh rdsh deps build # incremental index under $DSH_HOME/rdsh-index rdsh deps query engine_score # where a symbol is defined and referenced rdsh deps impact src/context.rs # direct/transitive dependents + affected tests ``` The extractor covers Rust, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, and Go and records imports, definitions, and static call sites per file. Unchanged files (same size and mtime) are reused, so repeated runs stay fast. It is a static approximation: dynamic dispatch, indirect calls, macros, and generated code remain explicitly `unknown` and are reported as unresolved counts rather than guessed, and a missing index means "no information", never "no dependencies". When the index exists, `rdsh context build` and `rdsh context inject` also pull in the graph neighbours of the files their search matched, so a retrieved excerpt arrives with the files it actually depends on. Native execution overhead is ~1 ms per invocation. ## Low-end hosts Default profile: `RDSH_DEFAULT_PROFILE`, then `general.default_profile` in rdsh settings, then local `tui`, else a guided error. Set the saved default with `rdsh settings set general.default_profile web`; an explicit `--profile ` keeps its precedence. rdsh aims to remain useful on modest machines: older x86-64 CPUs, older Linux distributions, and hosts without Node.js installed. - **Faster Node startup.** When rdsh launches dsh, it sets `NODE_COMPILE_CACHE` to `~/.cache/rdsh-node-compile-cache`, letting Node reuse compiled code across launches (Node 22.1 or newer; older versions ignore it). An existing `NODE_COMPILE_CACHE` value is preserved. Set `RDSH_NODE_COMPILE_CACHE=0`, or use `--passthrough` / `RDSH_PASSTHROUGH=1`, to opt out. Set `RDSH_NODE_COMPILE_CACHE=` to keep the cache at a fixed location instead of the default, for example on hosts where `$HOME` is volatile. - **Broad CPU support.** Prebuilt x86-64 binaries do not require AVX or BMI; the static musl build also runs on systems with older glibc. - **Session token estimates.** `sessions --tokens` reads a decompressed size from the zstd frame header when available. Most streaming frames need the `zstd -dc` fallback. Results are cached under `~/.cache/rdsh/sessions-tokens.json` (`$XDG_CACHE_HOME` takes precedence); set `RDSH_TOKENS_CACHE=0` to disable the cache. A `?` marks an estimate that could not be read, for example when the zstd CLI is unavailable. - **Bounded parallel work.** Search and session scans use at most eight worker threads. The zstd CLI fallback uses 8 to 32 parallel processes. - **Native commands without Node.** Commands such as `tokens`, `search`, and `sessions` keep working without Node. To delegate conversations, install `@deepseek-ai/dsh` or set `DSH_ORIG_BIN` (or `RDSH_ORIG_BIN`). - **Low-priority updates.** `sync-dsh.sh` updates dsh and rdsh, verifies archive bytes against that registry, and rolls back a failed update candidate. By default it uses the stable release selected by the reviewed repository digest registry; set `RDSH_SYNC_FROM_SOURCE=1` to build from `main` under `nice -n 19` and `ionice -c3` when available. The systemd unit runs at low priority; adjust its `ExecStart` to your checkout. ## Web UI & Dashboard ### Lightweight Local Web UI (`rdsh serve`) A lightweight status and token estimation page running on localhost (default `:38080`, does not conflict with DSH `:3080`): ```sh rdsh settings set extras.enable serve # enable the server feature rdsh serve # launch (bound to localhost, protected with a one-time token) ``` ### Product language rdsh-owned CLI diagnostics and the native local page support English, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese. Choose one run with `--language`, or persist it in `rdsh.json`; the default `auto` reads the first nonblank locale environment variable, falling back to English when it is absent or unsupported. ```sh rdsh --language ja settings show rdsh settings set general.language zh-CN ``` Precedence is `--language`, `RDSH_LANG`, `general.language`, then `LC_ALL`, `LC_MESSAGES`, and `LANG`. An explicitly invalid `general.language` stops the command without rewriting the settings file. Delegated `dsh` arguments, model output, JSON fields, files, and protocol identifiers are not translated. Interactive setup prompts and settings/policy validation use the selected language too. Authentication decisions and skipped-provider notes localize only the CLI presentation; their existing JSON strings remain unchanged, including malformed or oversized guard-input reasons. Native search continues to refuse unsupported non-Unix platforms before accessing the requested directory. `worker-scope validate` and `worker-scope policy` also localize their help and CLI diagnostics. These pure commands and their help ignore unrelated corrupt settings; ordinary commands and root help still report the settings error. Canonical JSON, policy codes and supplied paths stay unchanged. ### Protected delegated tools The opt-in agent tool sandbox supports Linux x86_64 with bubblewrap, prlimit, and unprivileged user namespaces. Its audited DSH/tool-runtime pairs are `0.2.0-rc.2`, `0.2.1-alpha.1`, and `0.2.1-alpha.3`, with matching versions in each pair. It verifies package metadata, runtime bytes and the loaded module, then limits inspection to explicitly shared files. Unknown, mixed, modified or unexpectedly resolved runtimes stop before delegation. macOS and Windows refuse protected delegation; ordinary delegation keeps the original tools. This matrix applies to the Rust launcher. Project-pinned dashboard releases retain their separate [supported tuple](docs/STAGED-UPDATES.md#capture-trusted-runtime-code). ### Extended Dashboard (`rdsh-dashboard`) Optional Node.js dashboard for project metrics, human-in-the-loop Q&A, and mobile access (requires Node.js 22+): ```sh rdsh-dashboard project --project ``` *On native Windows, the dashboard runs in the system tray and can be opened or stopped from the taskbar (`--no-tray` keeps it in the terminal). See [dashboard/README.md](dashboard/README.md). External agent CLIs (cursor-agent, devin) can be run as supervised jobs: see [docs/AGENT-RUNNERS.md](docs/AGENT-RUNNERS.md).* ## Desktop App (Electron) DeepSeek Harness Desktop is an Electron shell around the complete Web application. It shares `$DSH_HOME` with the CLI but owns a **reserved profile** (`$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop`) and its own bundled command runtime, so the npm `dsh` CLI cannot manage its plugins. `rdsh desktop` detects all of that and forwards plugin attachment to the app's own command — rdsh never boots or rewrites the profile: ```sh rdsh desktop status # ap

# dsh-headless-display 在**隔离的虚拟 X display** 里运行并操作 GUI 程序 —— 默认**桌面上零窗口、零干扰**。 给 Agent 提供 **10 个工具**（含环境自检），并在 DSH Web 界面里提供一个**可看可点的实时画面面板**。 - **默认后端 `Xvfb`（真 headless）**：桌面上不开任何窗口 - 想看/想亲手操作时，用面板上的「打开真实窗口」按需弹出 （`sway` 后端用 **`wayvnc`**，其余后端用 **`x11vnc`**；都只监听回环） - 可选后端 `Xephyr`：直接在用户桌面上开一个可见窗口（旧的可见行为） > 本插件由 `dsh-ego-browser` 与自建的 `tools/isolated_display.sh` 演进而来； > 设计目标见下文「为什么需要隔离 display」。 ### 名称沿革（为什么改过几次名） `@local/isolated-display` → `@local/gui-isolation` → `dsh-isolated-x11` → **`dsh-headless-display`** 改动原因**不是**反复无常，而是 dsh 的一个硬约束：**宿主插件模块按「包名」做进程级缓存** （详见下文「维护者必读」第 2 个坑）—— 改了 JS 之后， `set_plugin` 开关、`remove_bundle` + `install_bundle`、改入口文件名、换目录路径 **都无法加载新代码**，只有**换包名**或**重启 dsh** 才行。 所以开发期每改一次宿主代码就得换一次名；最后一次改名同时反映了行为变化 （默认后端从 Xephyr 改为 headless 的 Xvfb）。GitHub 仓库也随之改名， 旧链接会自动重定向；旧提交信息里的名字是当时的历史事实，保留不改写。 --- ## 目录 - [为什么需要隔离 display](#为什么需要隔离-display) - [静默保证：用户桌面上为什么不会多出窗口](#静默保证用户桌面上为什么不会多出窗口) - [功能](#功能) - [安装](#安装) - [配置](#配置) - [Agent 工具](#agent-工具) - [HTTP API](#http-api) - [Web UI 面板](#web-ui-面板) - [架构](#架构) - [⚠️ 维护者必读：三个已经踩过的坑](#️-维护者必读三个已经踩过的坑) - [已知限制](#已知限制) - [部署到其他设备](#部署到其他设备) - [故障排查](#故障排查) - [许可证](#许可证) --- ## 静默保证：用户桌面上为什么不会多出窗口 「静默」不是口号，而是**两个具体故障的反面** —— 都实测踩过，现在由代码硬保证。 ### ① 隔离 display 的编号不能靠「探活失败」来判定 旧实现先记「启动前还活着的 display」，再抓新出现的 socket。它依赖 XAUTHORITY 探测成功， 而 `xauthority` 配置在换机器 / 重启桌面后会失效（`xauth_XXXXXX` 每次可能换名）。 一旦探活全失败，**用户桌面的 `:1` 就会被当成「新建的 display」**。 实测后果：`iso_display_run` 返回的 `DISPLAY=:1`、`xdpyinfo` 报 **1920x1200（用户屏）**， 命令全跑在用户桌面上。 现在的判据是**进程归属**：sway 以 detached 启动、是进程组组长，Xwayland 由它拉起， 所以只认 `pgid/ppid === sway.pid` 的那个 Xwayland；再叠两道安全网： - 绝不接受「启动前活着」或「等于桌面 display」的编号； - 所有**写操作**（run / capture / windows / input / popout）都要求该 display 有本插件的 状态文件 —— 外部 display 默认一律拒绝（`allowForeignDisplays: true` 可放开）。 ### ② 只删 `WAYLAND_DISPLAY` 不够 libwayland 在 `WAYLAND_DISPLAY` 为空时**默认连 `$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/wayland-0`** —— 正是用户桌面的合成器。宿主进程的 env 里本来就有 `WAYLAND_DISPLAY=wayland-0`； 只删掉它，GTK 仍会以 Wayland 客户端身份连上桌面（实测 `zenity` 进程的 `/proc//fd` 里出现 `memfd:wayland-cursor`）。 所以 `iso_display_run` 起的子进程默认**显式钉到 X11**： ```text GDK_BACKEND=x11 QT_QPA_PLATFORM=xcb SDL_VIDEODRIVER=x11 ELECTRON_OZONE_PLATFORM_HINT=x11 XDG_SESSION_TYPE=x11 （并清掉 WAYLAND_DISPLAY / XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP） ``` X11 客户端由 Xwayland（sway 后端）或 Xvfb 承载，于是 `xdotool`（XTEST）/ `xwininfo` / 逐窗口聚焦都能工作，窗口也不可能漏到桌面。 > **要用 Wayland 原生客户端**（只有 Wayland 后端的程序）：配置 > `exposeWaylandClients: true`，或给 `iso_display_run` 的 `env` 传**绝对路径**的 > `WAYLAND_DISPLAY`（如 `/run/user/1000/dsh-iso-1/wayland-1`）。 > 代价：xdotool 够不到那些 Wayland 窗口，键鼠注入会失效。 ### ③ 画面隔离了，声音没有 隔离 display 只换掉了 X server / Wayland compositor，**音频仍然走用户默认声卡**。 实测：在隔离 display 里起 Desynced，主菜单音乐从头到尾从扬声器放出来 —— 「静默」只做到了一半。 现在 `iso_display_start` 会给每个 display 建一个 **null sink**（音频丢弃）： ```text pactl load-module module-null-sink sink_name=dsh-iso-2 … ``` `iso_display_run` 起的进程被注入 `PULSE_SINK=dsh-iso-2`，于是 PulseAudio / PipeWire 客户端（paplay、SDL/ffplay、Proton/Wine 的 winepulse…） 的音频全部落进这个 sink，**扬声器一点声音都没有**，而程序侧的音频初始化完全正常 （不会因为「没有声卡」报错或卡住）。`iso_display_stop` 会卸载对应 module。 实测（本机 PipeWire 1.4.2）： | 客户端 | 结果 | |---|---| | `paplay`（libpulse 路径） | `Connected to device dsh-iso-2 (index: 5810)` —— 落在 null sink | | `ffplay`（SDL 路径，多数游戏引擎同源） | sink-input 出现在 `dsh-iso-*`，默认声卡无新增流 | | 用户自己的游戏（Terraria） | 仍在默认声卡上，完全不受影响 | > ⚠️ **踩坑：创建虚拟 sink 会把用户的默认声卡静音** > > 本机（PipeWire 1.4.2 + WirePlumber + KDE）实测：只要新增一个虚拟 sink > （`pactl load-module module-null-sink` 或 `pw-cli create-node adapter` 都一样）， > **用户默认输出设备立刻变成静音**（`pactl get-sink-mute` → `yes`），而且卸载后不会自动恢复。 > 这会把「静默隔离」变成「把用户正在听的音乐/游戏静音」—— 用户实测抓到过。 > > 现在的做法：创建前记录默认设备与静音状态 → 创建后立刻恢复（结果里 > `audio.keptUserAudioUnmuted: true`）→ **display 存活期间还有一个 250ms 的 keeper**： > 一旦发现「sink 数量增加」（不论是谁加的，包括 Proton/Steam 自己建的 sink）， > 就把用户的默认设备与静音状态拉回启动时的值；`iso_display_stop` 卸载后再恢复一次。 > keeper **只在新 sink 出现时动作**，所以用户自己手动静音不会被抢回去； > 也不要碰音量。结果里会返回 `userAudioRestores`（一共纠正了几次）。 > 可用 `protectUserAudio: false` 完全关掉。 > sink 同时带 `node.hidden=true`，不会出现在桌面音量面板里。 > 配置 `audio: 'inherit'` 可回到旧行为（声音外放，非静默）。 > `iso_display_doctor` 会报告 `audio: {mode, pactl, server, defaultSink, isolatedSinks}`， > 缺 `pactl` 或声音服务连不上时告警「声音会从扬声器出来」。 > **盲点**：直接打开 ALSA 设备（`aplay -D hw:0`）或自带音频后端的程序绕过 Pulse，不会被隔离。 ### 验证方法（本仓库作者的实测做法） KDE 下用 KWin 脚本（`org.kde.kwin.Scripting`）每 2 秒采样一次窗口清单， 跑完整套自动化后与基线做 diff；再用 `spectacle` 定时抓桌面截图旁证。 **出现任何新窗口**（`iso_display_popout` 的查看器除外）就算静默失败。 --- ## 三种后端：默认静默 / 按需弹窗 | 后端 | 桌面上有窗口 | **DRI3** | Vulkan | 适用 | |---|---|---|---|---| | **`sway`（auto 下的首选）** | 否 | **有** | **GPU（RADV 等）** | **Proton / DX12 / 3D 游戏**，也兼容 2D | | `xvfb` | 否 | 无 | 仅 lavapipe（CPU 软渲） | 2D / X11 程序，最轻量 | | `xephyr` | **是**（会打扰用户） | 无 | ✗ | 想一边跑一边直接看真实窗口 | **`backend: auto`（默认）**：探测到 `sway` 就用 `sway`，否则退回 `xvfb`。 显式写 `sway` / `xvfb` / `xephyr` 可强制指定。 > **为什么 3D 游戏必须用 `sway`**：Xvfb 与 Xephyr 都**不提供 DRI3**， > Vulkan 的 WSI 会打印 > `No 为什么需要隔离 display 目标机器的桌面往往是 **KDE / GNOME 的 Wayland 会话**。在 Wayland 主桌面上： | 想做的事 | 现实 | |---|---| | 把输入注入到**非焦点窗口** | ❌ XTEST 只打给当前焦点；`XSendEvent` 多数程序（含 Proton/UE）不理会 | | 抓某个窗口的图 | ❌ XWayland 下 `import -window root` 直接 `BadMatch` | | 安静地跑自动化 | ❌ 一定会抢焦点、占满屏，干扰用户 | **解法**：另起一个**独立的 X server**，自动化全部在它内部进行，与用户会话完全隔离。 - **`auto`/`sway`（推荐）**：headless sway + Xwayland，**桌面零窗口**且**有 GPU**。 - **`Xvfb`**：纯 headless、最轻，但**无 GPU**（3D 游戏跑不了）。 - **`Xephyr`**：在用户桌面上开一个普通窗口，内部同样是独立 X server。 在这个独立 display 里，XTEST / XSendEvent / 抓屏全部正常。 --- ## 功能 - **10 个 Agent 工具**：环境自检、启停隔离 display、在其中跑命令、抓屏、列窗口、 注入键鼠，以及按需弹出/收起真实窗口 - **Web 侧边栏面板**：实时画面 + 点击操作 + 文本/按键注入 + 窗口列表 + 真实窗口开关 - **宿主 HTTP API**：9 条 `/gui-isolation/*` 路由，面板与外部脚本都可用 - **跨发行版**：`iso_display_doctor` 按 Debian / Fedora / Arch 给安装命令； 路径全部自动探测，换机器不用手改配置 - **零 npm 依赖**：纯 JS，无构建步骤 --- ## 安装 ### 前置（Linux / X11 或 Wayland） > **按发行版安装**：不用手抄下面的命令 —— 装好插件后先跑 `iso_display_doctor`， > 它会列出本机缺什么，并直接给出 `apt` / `dnf` / `pacman` 的可粘贴命令。 > 下面以 Debian 系为例。 ```bash # sway 后端（默认 auto 下首选；跑 3D / Proton 游戏必需） sudo apt install sway grim x11-utils xdotool imagemagick # 说明：sway 自带 Xwayland；grim 用于抓屏（Xwayland 下 import 取不到根窗口） # xvfb 后端（无 GPU 时的退路 / 纯 2D 自动化） sudo apt install xvfb # 「打开真实窗口」所需 # x11vnc —— xvfb / xephyr 后端 # wayvnc —— sway 后端（它的 display 是 Xwayland，x11vnc 在此不可用） # gvncviewer —— 实际的查看器窗口 sudo apt install x11vnc wayvnc gvncviewer # 想用可见窗口后端（backend: xephyr）再装： sudo apt install xserver-xephyr # 验证 command -v sway grim Xvfb Xwayland xdpyinfo xdotool import identify x11vnc wayvnc gvncviewer ``` > **sway 能跑但 GPU 不可用？** 确认当前用户在 `render` 组里（`id -nG | tr ' ' '\n' | grep render`）； > wlroots 的 headless 后端要打开 `/dev/dri/renderD*`。 - `Xephyr` —— 隔离 display 本体 - `xdpyinfo` —— 探活 - `xdotool` —— 注入键鼠 - `import` / `identify`（ImageMagick）—— 抓屏 ### 安装插件 把本目录放到任意位置，然后在 DSH 里安装该**目录 bundle**： ``` plugin_manager(action: "install_bundle", target: "<本目录的绝对路径>") ``` 安装后确认： ``` plugin_manager(action: "list_bundles") # 应出现 dsh-headless-display，rows: gui-isolation ``` ### 验证 ``` iso_display_start → {"display": ":9", "size": "1280x720", ...} iso_display_run ":9" sh ["-c", "setsid xclock &"] iso_display_capture ":9" → PNG 路径 iso_display_stop ":9" ``` --- ## 跑 Windows / DX 游戏（Proton / Steam 兼容套件） **已实测**：Desynced（Unreal 引擎、DX12、只有 Win64 二进制）在 `sway` 后端的隔离 display 里**完整渲染、桌面上零窗口**；音频默认被丢进该 display 的 null sink，**不会从扬声器出来**。 ![Desynced 在隔离 display 里运行](docs/desynced-in-isolated-display.jpg) > 上图由 `iso_display_capture` 抓取（1280x720，`via: grim`，约 49 万色）。 > 同一时间段内用户桌面的窗口清单**没有任何新增窗口**（只有 Steam 自身的通知气泡在闪）， > 键盘/鼠标注入也能点到游戏菜单（可切换菜单项、打开子菜单）。 ### 要点 1. **必须用 `sway` 后端** —— Xvfb/Xephyr 无 DRI3，Vulkan 退到 llvmpipe， UE 游戏直接抛 `EXCEPTION_INT_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO`。 2. **绕开 Steam 客户端直接调 Proton** —— `steam -applaunch` 由 Steam 客户端进程 带着**它自己的**环境启动游戏，调用方设的 `DISPLAY` 传不进去。 3. 用 `iso_display_run` + `setsid ... &`（该工具是同步的，GUI 程序必须后台化）。 ### 一键启动：`scripts/run-proton.sh` **不要自己拼 `STEAM_COMPAT_*`** —— 库目录、前缀、Proton 版本因机器而异， 手写模板最容易把 `DISPLAY` 漏在 Steam 客户端那一侧（于是游戏开到用户桌面上）。 ```bash scripts/run-proton.sh --list 1450900 # 只打印探测结果，不启动 ``` ```text appid : 1450900 (Desynced) library : /media/user/F-DataShared/SteamLibrary install dir : …/steamapps/common/Desynced compatdata : …/steamapps/compatdata/1450900 prefix version : 11.0-100 proton : …/common/Proton 11.0 ← 优先匹配前缀版本 exe : …/Desynced/Binaries/Win64/Desynced.exe ``` 它做的事：枚举 `libraryfolders.vdf` 里所有库 → 找 `appmanifest_.acf` → 读 `compatdata//version` 选**同版本** Proton（找不到才退 Experimental/Hotfix） → 定位 exe（`.exe` → `Binaries/Win64/*.exe`，排除 CrashReport/Launcher） → 设 `STEAM_COMPAT_CLIENT_INSTALL_PATH / DATA_PATH / INSTALL_PATH / SteamAppId` → `exec proton run `。 在隔离 display 里启动（`iso_display_run` 是同步的，GUI 程序必须后台化）： ```bash iso_display_start # → :2（backend: sway, gpu: true） iso_display_run ":2" sh ["-c", "setsid /path/to/scripts/run-proton.sh 1450900 -log > /tmp/game.log 2>&1 &"] iso_display_capture ":2" # 截图确认渲染 iso_display_stop ":2" ``` 要给游戏加环境变量时，用工具的 `env` 参数即可（不必改脚本）： ```json {"display": ":2", "command": "sh", "args": ["-c", "setsid /path/to/scripts/run-proton.sh 1450900 &"], "env": {"WINEDEBUG": "-all", "SteamAppId": "1450900"}} ``` ### 踩过的坑 | 现象 | 原因 / 解法 | |---|---| | 抓屏全黑 / 报 `import: ... BadMatch` | Xwayland 下 `import -window root` 取不到根窗口。**插件已自动改用 `grim`** 抓 Wayland 输出；手工抓屏时记得给 `XDG_RUNTIME_DIR` + `WAYLAND_DISPLAY`，别只给 `DISPLAY` | | `steam -applaunch` 起在了桌面上 | 见上文第 2 点，改直接调 `proton` | | Proton 版本与前缀不匹配 | `compatdata//version` 记着建前缀用的版本（本机是 `11.0-100`）。用别的版本会触发前缀更新，慢但可用 | | 起不来但无报错 | 看 `/tmp/game.log`；`pgrep -x .exe` 确认进程是否真的起来了 | --- ## 配置 在 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `config` `iso_display_doctor`） | | `GET` | `/gui-isolation/state` | `{displays:[{display,alive,size,pid}], defaultSize, parentDisplay}` | | `GET` | `/gui-isolation/snapshot?display=:9` | `image/png` 整屏截图 | | `GET` | `/gui-isolation/windows?display=:9` | `{windows:[...]}` | | `POST` | `/gui-isolation/start` | body `{size?, display?}` | | `POST` | `/gui-isolation/stop` | body 或 query `display` | | `POST` | `/gui-isolation/input` | body `{display, kind, key?, text?, x?, y?, window?}` | 示例： ```bash curl -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"size":"1024x768"}' \ http://127.0.0.1:3080/gui-isolation/start curl -o shot.png "http://127.0.0.1:3080/gui-isolation/snapshot?display=%3A9" curl -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' \ -d '{"display":":9","kind":"click","x":100,"y":200}' \ http://127.0.0.1:3080/gui-isolation/input ``` > 这些路由**不受 dsh 的浏览器鉴权 cookie 限制**（实测 curl 直接可用）， > 但默认只监听本机回环地址。**不要**把 3080 暴露到公网。 --- ## Web UI 面板 `client.js` 提供一个「隔离显示」面板：实时画面（约 0.9s 轮询）、点画面即在该坐标点击、 文本输入、常用按键、窗口列表、启停按钮，以及**「打开真实窗口 / 关闭真实窗口」**开关。 落点策略： - 装了 **`dsh-better-sidebar`** → 注册成**右侧栏标签页**（`ctx.betterSidebar.registerTab`）。 标签页渲染在侧栏那一列内部，结构上不可能覆盖其它区域。 - 没装 → **不注册任何 UI**（Agent 工具与 HTTP API 仍然可用）。 > ⚠️ 曾经有一个「回退到 `shell.overlay` 浮动面板」的分支，**已彻底删除**： > `shell.overlay` 是贯穿整个窗口的浮层，配上 `height:100%` + 不透明背景的面板 > 会把整个 Web UI 盖死，用户点不到任何东西，只能从外部远程窗口通知 Agent 才回滚掉。 > **教训：绝不要把大尺寸组件挂到 frame-wide 浮层上；宁可没有 UI，也不能挡住用户。** 样式只用宿主主题 token（`--dsw-alias-*`），不引入任何 Harness Client 包。 --- ## 架构 ``` ┌─ 浏览器 ────────────────────────────────┐ ┌───────────────▼─────────────────────────┐ │ plugin.js（宿主） │ │ ctx.tools.register(...) × 9 个工具 │ │ ctx.webServer.register(...) × 8 路由 │ │ ctx.betterSidebar 由 client 侧使用 │ └───────────────┬─────────────────────────┘ │ execFile ┌───────────────▼─────────────────────────┐ │ Xvfb（默认，headless） / Xephyr（可选） │ │ 独立 X server（如 :9） │ │ 默认桌面上无窗口；按需 popout 出真实窗口 │ │ 你的被测程序跑在这里 │ └─────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` **后端可插拔**：所有 display 操作集中在 `start/stop/snapshotBuffer/windows/input` 几个函数里。 要接第二个后端（例如 MaaFramework 修好后的 `WlrRootsController`），在这几个函数上分派即可。 --- ## ⚠️ 维护者必读：三个已经踩过的坑 ### 1. 插件的 `Config` 不能是裸 JSON Schema Cordis 的实现是： ```js function resolveConfig(runtime, config) { if (!runtime.Config) return config; const result = runtime.Config["~standard"].validate(config); // ← 需要 Standard Schema ... } ``` 声明成裸 JSON Schema 会报 `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'validate')`， **插件直接激活失败**。零依赖的纯 JS bundle 拿不到 schema 库， 所以**干脆不要声明 `Config`**，把默认值写在代码里。 （`/home/user/deepseek-harness/vendor/cordis/lib/index.js:956`） ### 2. ★ 模块被**进程级缓存**：改了 JS 代码，重装也不会加载新代码 **实测结论（2026-10-11）**： | 手段 | 能否加载新代码 | |---|---| | `set_plugin` 关→开 | ❌ | | `remove_bundle` + `install_bundle` | ❌ | | 改**入口文件名**（`index.js` → `plugin.js`） | ❌ | | 换**目录路径**（同样的包名） | ❌ | | **换包名** | ✅ | 缓存按**包名**键控。所以： > **开发期每改一次宿主代码，就要换一次包名，或者重启 dsh。** > 正式维护时，改完代码**重启 dsh** 是最省事的路径（规范也写明「替换已安装的包需要重启」）。 ### 3. dsh 宿主进程**不继承**桌面的 `DISPLAY` / `XAUTHORITY` 实测宿主进程的 environ 里这两个变量**都没有**。因此： - 不配置就会连不上 X server（Xephyr 起不来 / xdotool 报错） - 代码里有自动探测兜底：`$XAUTHORITY` → `/run/user//xauth_*` → `~/.Xauthority` - 但**显式配置最稳**（见 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `parentDisplay` / `xauthority`） ### 4. 判断 `betterSidebar` 可用性**不能**用 `ctx.get()` better-sidebar 是通过 **`ctx.provide("betterSidebar", service)`** 发布服务的， 它**晚于**本插件 apply。所以： ```js // ❌ 错：此刻拿到 undefined，标签页永远不注册（表现为「右栏根本没有这个选项」） if (!ctx.get('betterSidebar')) return ctx.inject(['betterSidebar'], cb) // ✅ 对：Cordis 会等待依赖就绪；真的没有时回调不执行，自然没有任何 UI ctx.inject(['betterSidebar'], cb) ``` 另外：`betterSidebar` **不在** Cordis 的 Service 目录里， `cordis_inspect_query(platform:"client", provider:"Service")` 查不到它 —— **别因为查不到就以为它不存在**。 --- ## 已知限制 | 限制 | 说明 | |---|---| | **`xvfb` / `xephyr` 跑不了 Vulkan / 3D** | 两者都**不提供 DRI3**。`vulkaninfo` 会报 *No DRI3 support detected - required for presentation*，Vulkan 退到 llvmpipe；UE 游戏启动即 `EXCEPTION_INT_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO`。**3D / Proton 游戏请用 `sway` 后端**（有 DRI3，Vulkan 直通 GPU）。 | | `iso_display_run` 是同步的 | 跑不会退出的 GUI 程序会占满超时。用 `sh -c "setsid <程序> &"` 后台起。 | | 画面靠轮询 | 约 0.9s 一帧。要更流畅可改成 WebSocket + MJPEG/VP8 流。 | | 无输入法/多指手势 | 只有 `xdotool` 能力范围内的键鼠。 | | 默认只监听回环 | 不要把 3080 暴露到公网。 | | 弹出窗口不一定到最前 | KDE Wayland 下 XWayland 窗口抬不过原生 Wayland 窗口（平台限制） | | `backend: xephyr` 会开窗口 | 会打扰用户；除非确实需要，否则保持默认 `auto` | | `sway` 启动慢于 xvfb | 要连起 wlroots + Xwayland 两个进程，首次约 3–6 秒（xvfb 约 1 秒）。换来的是 GPU。 | | `sway` 需要 `render` 组 | wlroots headless 要打开 `/dev/dri/renderD*`。不在组里会退到软件渲染（仍能跑，只是慢）。 | | `sway` 序号上限 20 | 只有 sway 进程**仍然活着**的序号才算占用；异常退出留下的 runDir 会在下次启动时被复用并清理。 | | **默认强制 X11** | 子进程被钉到 X11（`GDK_BACKEND` / `QT_QPA_PLATFORM` / `SDL_VIDEODRIVER` / `ELECTRON_OZONE_PLATFORM_HINT`）。只有 Wayland 后端的程序需要 `exposeWaylandClients: true`，但那时 `xdotool` 够不到它们的窗口。 | | **音频隔离有盲点** | 只有走 PulseAudio/PipeWire 客户端的程序会被 `PULSE_SINK` 接管；直接打开 ALSA 设备或自带音频后端的程序仍会外放。`iso_display_doctor` 会检查 `pactl` 是否可用 | | **`setsid` 起的程序不保证随 display 退出** | `iso_display_stop` 会尽力清理 `DISPLAY` 指向该 display 的进程（`killClientsOnStop`，默认开），但读不到 `/proc//environ` 的进程（non-dumpable）会被跳过 | | **外部 display 默认不可操作** | 防止误伤用户桌面；确需操作请设 `allowForeignDisplays: true` | | **x11vnc 在 sway 后端不可用** | 硬限制：Xwayland 上 `XGetImage` 会 `BadMatch`。插件已自动改用 `wayvnc`；手工调试时别混用。 | --- ## 部署到其他设备 目标：换一台 Linux（Debian/Ubuntu、Fedora、Arch…）几分钟装好，**不用手改路径**。 1. **取到本目录**（`git clone` 或拷贝） 2. **安装**：`plugin_manager(action:"install_bundle", target:"<本目录绝对路径>")` 3. **自检**：调用 `iso_display_doctor` - `ok: true` → 直接 `iso_display_start` - `missing` 非空 → 按返回的 `install` 一行命令装好 - `warnings` 里有 GPU / 查看器 / 桌面临接的提示 4. **验证**：`iso_display_start` → `iso_display_run` 起个窗口 → `iso_display_capture` 5. 装了 `dsh-better-sidebar` 时，刷新页面能在右栏看到「隔离显示」 **不需要**再手改 `parentDisplay` / `xauthority`： - `parentDisplay` 默认取 `$DISPLAY`，拿不到时探活 `:1` - `xauthority` 自动扫描 `/run/user//xauth_*` 与 `~/.Xauthority`； 配置里写过但文件不存在时**忽略并回退自动探测** （旧版正是被过期路径坑到：探活全失败 → 把用户桌面的 `:1` 当成新建的隔离 display） - sway 私有 runtime 目录按 `/run/user/` → `$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR` → `$TMPDIR` 依次回退， 非 systemd 发行版也能用 > 包名对应关系：Debian/Ubuntu、Fedora、Arch 给可直接粘贴的命令； > 其它发行版给通用包名清单（避免编错包名带偏）。 --- ## 故障排查 | 现象 | 原因 / 处理 | |---|---| | `iso_display_start` 返回的 display 是 `:1` 之类、`iso_display_run` 里 `DISPLAY` 指向用户屏 | 旧版故障（`xauthority` 过期 → 误判）。v1.3.0 已改用进程组判定；若仍出现，先跑 `iso_display_doctor` 看 `x11.xauthority` | | 程序窗口跑到用户桌面上 | 用了 Wayland 原生客户端：默认已钉 X11；如果你设了 `exposeWaylandClients: true` 或 `env.WAYLAND_DISPLAY`，Wayland 窗口就会进隔离合成器，但**不会**到桌面。若真到桌面，检查是否直接用了 `steam -applaunch`（见 Proton 章节） | | 缺依赖但报错只有一句 `spawn ENOENT` | 跑 `iso_display_doctor`，`missing` + `install` 会告诉你要装什么 | | `sway` 起不来又不知道原因 | `iso_display_doctor` 看 `backends.sway` / `gpu` / `dirs`；再手工跑 `WLR_BACKENDS=headless WLR_LIBINPUT_NO_DEVICES=1 sway -c /dev/null` | | 插件行 `fiberPhase: failed`，报 `...reading 'validate'` | 声明了 `Config` —— 删掉它（见坑 1） | | 改了代码但行为没变 | 模块缓存（见坑 2）—— 换包名或重启 dsh | | `iso_display_start` 报「Xephyr 未能在 :N 上就绪」 | `parentDisplay` 或 `xauthority` 不对（见坑 3）；手动跑一次 `DISPLAY=:1 Xephyr :9 -screen 1280x720 -ac` 看报错 | | 抓屏是纯黑/纯色 | 该 display 里确实没有窗口；先用 `iso_display_run` 起个程序 | | 面板里没有画面 | 确认 display 存活（`iso_display_list`），以及 `/gui-isolation/state` 能返回 | | 3D 程序秒退 / 报 VKD3D 或 D3D 错误 | 该后端无 DRI3。**改用 `sway`**（见「已知限制」） | | `sway` 后端启动超时 | 手动验证：`WLR_BACKENDS=headless WLR_LIBINPUT_NO_DEVICES=1 sway -c /dev/null`，看能否起来；再 `command -v Xwayland grim` | | **`sway` 崩溃（OOM / `kill -9`）后重启总是超时** | 被打断的 Xwayland 会留下**残留 socket 文件**（`/tmp/.X11-unix/X`，无进程监听）。插件已改为按「**启动前是否活着**」而非「socket 文件是否新增」发现 display，并在复用序号时清掉残留 runDir —— 现已能自愈 | | `sway` 起得来但游戏报 Vulkan 找不到设备 | 检查 `id -nG` 是否含 `render`；`ls -l /dev/dri/renderD*` | | `grim` 报找不到 wayland socket | 抓屏必须带该实例的 `XDG_RUNTIME_DIR` + `WAYLAND_DISPLAY`（插件已自动处理；手工抓屏常忘） | | x11vnc 报 `Wayland display server detected` 后退出 | 它靠**环境变量**判断会话类型，即使 `-display` 指向 Xwayland 也会拒绝。插件已剥掉 `WAYLAND_DISPLAY` / `XDG_SESSION_TYPE`；手工起 x11vnc 时同理 | | 真实窗口不出现，查看器瞬间退出 | 查看器有**两套不兼容的地址语法与选项**（见下），插件按实现自动选；手工调试时别混用 | | 页面看不到「隔离显示」标签 | 需要**刷新页面**；并确认 `dsh-better-sidebar` 已启用 | --- ## 文件 | 文件 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | `plugin.js` | 宿主：10 个工具 + 9 条 HTTP 路由 | | `client.js` | 浏览器：右栏标签页（better-sidebar 缺失时不注册任何 UI） | | `scripts/run-proton.sh` | 在隔离 display 里用 Proton 跑 Steam 游戏（自动探测库/前缀/版本/exe） | | `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle patch（插入 `gui-isolation` 行 + 配置） | | `locale/{en,zh}.json` | 插件卡片标题与描述 | | `icon.svg` | 插件图标 | --- ## 更新日志 ### v1.4.1（守住用户的静音状态） - 实测确认：本机**任何**新增 sink（module-null-sink / module-pipe-sink / Proton 自建） 都会把用户默认声卡置为静音，且不只发生在创建瞬间 —— 测试中途出现新 sink 时会再静音一次。 - 新增 `protectUserAudio`（默认开）：display 存活期间每 250ms 检查一次， **仅当 sink 数量增加时**把默认设备与静音状态拉回启动时的值；用户自己手动静音不受影响。 - `iso_display_stop` 返回 `userAudioRestores`（纠正次数）。 - 实测：外部新 sink 造成静音 → 800ms 内恢复；外部手动静音 → 保持不被抢回。 ### v1.4.0（音频也静默，且不碰用户正在听的音频） - **音频隔离**：每个 display 建一个隐藏的 `module-null-sink`（`dsh-iso-`）， `iso_display_run` 起的进程注入 `PULSE_SINK`，音频被丢弃；`iso_display_stop` 卸载。 实测 paplay（libpulse）与 ffplay（SDL）的流都落在 `dsh-iso-*`，用户自己的 游戏流（Terraria）仍在默认声卡，互不影响。 - **不静音用户音频**：创建虚拟 sink 会让默认声卡静音（PipeWire 1.4.2 实测）， 现在创建/卸载前后都会记录并恢复用户的默认设备与静音状态。 - sink 带 `node.hidden=true`，不出现在音量面板。 - 配置 `audio: 'null' | 'inherit'`（默认 `null`）。 - `iso_display_doctor` 新增 `audio` 段（pactl/服务端/默认 sink/已存在的隔离 sink）。 ### v1.3.3（无人值守泄漏可见化） - `iso_display_list` 每条记录增加 `ageMinutes`，超过 `staleDisplayMinutes`（默认 240） 时带 `stale: true`；`iso_display_doctor` 在 `warnings` 里点名泄漏的 display。 由来：极简提示词的黑盒子智能体中途失败时会留下仍活着的 display，事后必须能一眼看见。 - 新增只读诊断，不改变任何既有行为。 ### v1.3.2（第二轮黑盒测试收尾） - `iso_display_stop` 新增 `killClientsOnStop`（默认 `true`）：扫描 `/proc/*/environ`， 把 `DISPLAY` 指向该 display 的客户端一并收掉 —— `setsid` 起的 GUI 程序不会随 display 自动退出，实测会留下孤儿进程。结果里返回 `killedClients`。 - README 增加 Desynced 在隔离 display 内的实测截图。 ### v1.3.0（静默硬保证 + 跨发行版 + Proton 辅助脚本） **修复（都会让窗口/命令落到用户桌面上）** - **display 归属判定改用进程组**：旧实现靠「启动前是否活着」找新 display， `xauthority` 配置过期时会把用户桌面的 `:1` 当成隔离 display （实测 `iso_display_run` 报 `DISPLAY=:1`、1920x1200）。现在只认 `pgid/ppid === sway.pid` 的 Xwayland，并加两道安全网。 - **子进程钉到 X11**：只删 `WAYLAND_DISPLAY` 时 libwayland 会默认连 `$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/wayland-0`（用户桌面）。现在显式设 `GDK_BACKEND=x11` / `QT_QPA_PLATFORM=xcb` / `SDL_VIDEODRIVER=x11` / `ELECTRON_OZONE_PLATFORM_HINT=x11` / `XDG_SESSION_TYPE=x11`。 可用 `exposeWaylandClients: true` 或 `env` 里给绝对路径 socket 恢复 Wayland 客户端。 - **`xauthority` 过期路径**：配置值不存在时忽略并回退自动探测。 - **写操作只允许本插件启动的 display**（`allowForeignDisplays` 可放开）。 - **`spawn` 缺 `error` 监听**：缺二进制时 `ENOENT` 会抛未捕获异常带崩 dsh，已修。 - **wayvnc 参数**：`-r` 实为 `--render-cursor`、`-p` 实为 `--show-performance`， 端口只能走位置参数（0.9.1 实测）。旧写法只是「碰巧能用」，已改成明确写法并带重试。 - **`stop()` 不再用 `pkill -f`**（会误杀命令行里含同样字符串的进程）， 改按进程组 + 「进程名 + 参数前缀」精确收尾，并清理残留 socket/lock。 **新增** - `iso_display_doctor` 工具 + `/gui-isolation/doctor` 路由：依赖 / GPU / DRI3 / 目录可写 / 桌面 X 会话自检，按 Debian/Fedora/Arch 给安装命令。 - `iso_display_start` 支持按次指定 `backend`；`auto` 失败自动回退 `xvfb`。 - `iso_display_run` 支持 `env`（Proton 环境变量），并校验 `DISPLAY` / `WAYLAND_DISPLAY` 不能指回用户桌面。 - `scripts/run-proton.sh`：自动探测 Steam 库 / compatdata / Proton 版本 / exe。 - runDir 在无 `/run/user/` 时回退 `$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR` / `$TMPDIR`。 - `pickDisplay()` 自愈：残留 socket + lock 会被清掉复用编号。 **改进** - `sway --version` 探测改为懒执行（不再阻塞 dsh 启动最多 5 秒）。 - `snapshotBuffer()` 不再对 sway 后端抓两次屏。 - `listDisplays()` 的状态文件恢复改为同步读取（重启后立刻可用 `WAYLAND_DISPLAY`）。 --- ## 许可证 [MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 jingyingruodi
